  ```js
      var kq = G.danhTran({ten: st.ten, tech: st.tech, ships: f.ships}, {
  ```

  Preserve the two-argument solo contract, but do not preserve the current guard's skip. An omitted `options` allocates a fresh `{ value: 50_000 }`, returns an `AdvanceResult`, and leaves a same-second remainder due for the next two-argument call. Add a cooperative browser continuation so the result is not merely ignored:

  ```js
  // js/app.js
  APP._soloTickQueued = false;
  APP.tuaSolo = function () {
    if (!window.ST) return null;
    var result = G.tick(window.ST, G.giay());
    if (result && result.budgetExhausted && !APP._soloTickQueued) {
      APP._soloTickQueued = true;
      setTimeout(function () {
        APP._soloTickQueued = false;
        APP.tuaSolo(); U.live(); U.ve();
      }, 0);
    }
    return result;
  };
  // Replace both direct ticks in APP.batDauNhip with APP.tuaSolo().
  // js/main.js: replace G.tick(ST, G.giay()) in batDau with APP.tuaSolo().
  // js/actions.js
  G.chay = function (st, ten, dl) {
    var f = G.HANHDONG[ten], advanced;
    if (!f) return 'Hành động không tồn tại.';
    advanced = G.tick(st, G.giay());
    if (advanced && advanced.budgetExhausted) return G.TICK_PARTIAL;
    return f(st, dl || {}) || null;
  };
  // js/main.js's APP.lam schedules APP.tuaSolo() before returning G.TICK_PARTIAL to U.toast.
  ```

  Create the whole `server/scheduler/events.js` now, rather than leaving a
  reducer-only prose helper for Task 5/9 to import.  `derivePvpMatchId` and
  `deriveExternalJobs` are named exports and are the only matching/key
  derivation used by reducers and reconciliation:

  ```js
  'use strict';
  var crypto = require('node:crypto');
  var {G} = require('../rules.js');
  // This module intentionally has no Store dependency: Store imports the
  // match derivation for snapshot validation.  Keep the tiny canonical writer
  // here so Node never observes a circular partially-initialized export.
  function canonicalJson(value) {
    if (value === null || typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'boolean' ||
        typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) return JSON.stringify(value);
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return '[' + value.map(canonicalJson).join(',') + ']';
    if (Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Object]') {
      return '{' + Object.keys(value).sort().map(function (key) {
        return JSON.stringify(key) + ':' + canonicalJson(value[key]);
      }).join(',') + '}';
    }
    throw new Error('PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY');
  }
  function arrival(ref) {
    if (!ref || !Number.isSafeInteger(ref.arrivalAtS) || ref.arrivalAtS < 0) {
      throw new Error('PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY');
    }
    return ref.arrivalAtS;
  }
  function externalEntityId(ref) { return ref.kind === 'missile' ? ref.missileId : ref.fleetId; }
  function derivePvpMatchId(ref, defenderAccountId) {
    if (!ref || ref.kind !== 'fleet' || ref.mission !== 'attack' ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(defenderAccountId) || defenderAccountId < 1) {
      throw new Error('PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY');
    }
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalJson({
      ownerAccountId: ref.ownerAccountId,
      defenderAccountId: defenderAccountId,
      fleetId: ref.fleetId,
      launchAtS: ref.launchAtS,
      targetKey: ref.targetKey,
      arrivalAtS: arrival(ref),
      rule: 'pvp-v1'
    }), 'utf8').digest('hex');
  }
  function externalKey(ref) {
    return ['external', ref.kind, ref.mission, ref.ownerAccountId, externalEntityId(ref),
      ref.targetKey, ref.launchAtS, arrival(ref)].join(':');
  }
  function stableFleetRef(ownerAccountId, fleet) {
    if (!fleet || !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(fleet.id)) ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(fleet.diLuc)) ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(fleet.den_t))) throw new Error('PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY');
    return {kind: 'fleet', ownerAccountId: Number(ownerAccountId), fleetId: Number(fleet.id),
      launchAtS: Number(fleet.diLuc), targetKey: G.tdKey(fleet.den),
      arrivalAtS: Number(fleet.den_t), mission: fleet.mission};
  }
  function stableMissileRef(ownerAccountId, missile) {
    if (!missile || !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(missile.id)) ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(missile.khi))) throw new Error('PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY');
    var launchAtS = Number.isSafeInteger(Number(missile.diLuc)) ? Number(missile.diLuc) :
      Math.max(0, Number(missile.khi) - G.tgTenLua(Math.abs(Number(missile.den.h) - Number(missile.tu.h))));
    return {kind: 'missile', ownerAccountId: Number(ownerAccountId), missileId: Number(missile.id),
      launchAtS: launchAtS, targetKey: G.tdKey(missile.den),
      arrivalAtS: Number(missile.khi), mission: 'missile'};
  }
  function sameExternalRef(left, right) {
    if (!left || !right || left.kind !== right.kind ||
        Number(left.ownerAccountId) !== Number(right.ownerAccountId) ||
        left.targetKey !== right.targetKey || Number(left.arrivalAtS) !== Number(right.arrivalAtS) ||
        left.mission !== right.mission) return false;
    if (left.kind === 'missile') {
      return Number(left.missileId) === Number(right.missileId) &&
        Number(left.launchAtS) === Number(right.launchAtS);
    }
    return Number(left.fleetId) === Number(right.fleetId) &&
      Number(left.launchAtS) === Number(right.launchAtS);
  }
  function canonicalExternalStatus(kho, ref) {
    var row = kho.db.prepare('SELECT state FROM dq WHERE tk=?')
      .get(Number(ref.ownerAccountId));
    if (!row) return 'ALREADY_ABSENT';
    var state = JSON.parse(row.state);
    var list = ref.kind === 'missile' ? state.tenLua : state.fleets;
    var entityId = ref.kind === 'missile' ? Number(ref.missileId) : Number(ref.fleetId);
    var entity = (list || []).find(function (candidate) {
      return Number(candidate.id) === entityId;
    });
    if (!entity) return 'ALREADY_ABSENT';
    if (ref.kind === 'fleet' && entity.pha !== 'di') return 'ALREADY_ABSENT';
    var current = ref.kind === 'missile' ?
      stableMissileRef(Number(ref.ownerAccountId), entity) :
      stableFleetRef(Number(ref.ownerAccountId), entity);
    return sameExternalRef(current, ref) ? 'EXACT' : 'REF_MISMATCH';
  }
  function jobFromRef(ref, targetAccountForKey) {
    if (ref.kind === 'fleet' &&
        ['attack', 'transport', 'spy', 'hold'].indexOf(ref.mission) < 0) return null;
    var targetAccountId = targetAccountForKey(ref.targetKey);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(targetAccountId) || targetAccountId < 1 ||
        targetAccountId === Number(ref.ownerAccountId)) return null;
    if (ref.kind === 'fleet' && ref.mission === 'attack') {
      var matchId = derivePvpMatchId(ref, targetAccountId);
      return {kind: 'PVP_RESOLVE', scheduledAtS: arrival(ref), priority: 50,
        idempotencyKey: 'pvp-resolve:' + matchId + ':' + arrival(ref),
        aggregateType: 'match', aggregateId: matchId, expectedRevision: null,
        sourceAccountId: ref.ownerAccountId, maxAttempts: 8,
        payload: {schemaVersion: 1, matchId: matchId, ref: ref}};
    }
    return {kind: 'EXTERNAL_RESOLVE', scheduledAtS: arrival(ref),
      priority: ref.kind === 'missile' ? 51 : 50,
      idempotencyKey: externalKey(ref), aggregateType: ref.kind,
      aggregateId: String(externalEntityId(ref)), expectedRevision: null,
      sourceAccountId: ref.ownerAccountId, maxAttempts: 8,
      payload: {schemaVersion: 1, ref: ref}};
  }
  function deriveExternalJobs(accountId, state, targetAccountForKey) {
    var refs = G.phanLoaiTatCaSuKienNgoai(state, accountId) || [];
    return refs.map(function (ref) { return jobFromRef(ref, targetAccountForKey); })
      .filter(Boolean);
  }
  module.exports = {derivePvpMatchId: derivePvpMatchId, deriveExternalJobs: deriveExternalJobs,
    jobFromRef: jobFromRef,
    externalKey: externalKey, stableFleetRef: stableFleetRef, stableMissileRef: stableMissileRef,
    sameExternalRef: sameExternalRef, canonicalExternalStatus: canonicalExternalStatus};
  ```

**Files:**

- Consume: `server/scheduler/events.js` (created with its full body in Task 3)
- Modify: `server/db.js` only to add a lazy post-migration scheduler statement cache;
  do not touch Foundation's transaction implementation.

  global invalidation after Task 3 has supplied stable-ref inspection.

- Modify: `tools/test-scheduler.js`

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: Task 2 `SchedulerStore.replaceAccountAdvance/schedule`, Task 3 `G.phanLoaiSuKienKe`, and existing batch `TheGioi._ghiNhieu(ds, now)` projection ordering.
- Produces: `deriveExternalJobs(accountId, state, targetAccountForKey)`,
  `TheGioi(kho, { clock, scheduler })`, lazy revision-aware scheduler save,
  `TheGioi.prototype.datScheduler(schedulerStore)`,
  `TheGioi.prototype.datAdvanceService(advanceService)`,
  `TheGioi.prototype.trongMutationScheduler(mutation, fn)`, and private
  `TheGioi.prototype.advanceAccountNoiBo(mutation, accountId, targetS)`,
  `TheGioi.prototype.advanceDueNoiBo(mutation, targetS)`. Here the
  store/service capabilities are installed once by the adapter and never
  exported by `taoUngDung`; no public world method calls `G.tick` directly.
  `TheGioi.prototype.luu(accountId, state, options)` preserves its existing
  one-account call shape while its internal batch flush preserves
  `_ghiNhieu(ds, now)` and additionally accepts
  `{ mutation, currentAccountAdvanceJobId?, deferAccountWake? }` and returns
  `{ revision, nextLocalAtS }`.

  ```js
  };
  TheGioi.prototype.advanceDueNoiBo = function (mutation, targetS) {
    layMutationLuu(this, mutation);
    var rows = this.kho.q.dqDenHan.all(targetS, 60);
    var result = {processed: 0, budgetExhausted: false,
      deferredExternal: false, jobId: null, advanceResult: null};
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i += 1) {
      var one = this.advanceAccountNoiBo(mutation, Number(rows[i].tk), targetS);
      result.processed += one.processed;
      if (one.budgetExhausted || one.deferredExternal === true) {
        deferSecondaryAccount(mutation, Number(rows[i].tk), targetS, one);
        result.budgetExhausted = one.budgetExhausted === true;
        result.deferredExternal = one.deferredExternal === true;
        result.advanceResult = one;
        result.jobId = one.blockedExternalJobId || null;
        break;
      }
    }
    return result;
  };
  TheGioi.prototype.tick = function (tk, now, dl) {
    if (!this._scheduler) return foundationWorldBody.tick.call(this, tk, now, dl);
    var stack = this._mutationContexts || [];
    var mutation = layMutationLuu(this, stack[stack.length - 1] || null);
    var targetS = now === undefined || now === null ?
      Math.floor(mutation.effectiveNowMs / 1000) : Number(now);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(targetS) || targetS < 0) throw new Error('TICK_TARGET_INVALID');
    if (this.dangTick.has(Number(tk))) return null;
    this.dangTick.add(Number(tk));
    this.chuStack.push(Number(tk));
    this.mocTick.push(targetS);
    this.batDau();
    var loaded, state, ok = false;
    try {
      loaded = this.nap(Number(tk));
      if (!loaded) { ok = true; return null; }
      state = loaded.st;
      if (dl && typeof dl.truoc === 'function') dl.truoc(state);
      var advanced = this.advanceAccountNoiBo(mutation, Number(tk), targetS);
      if (deferSecondaryAccount(mutation, Number(tk), targetS, advanced)) {
        ok = true;
        return G.TICK_PARTIAL;
      }
      // `advanceTo` can have staged the exact state in this outer world batch;
      // do not re-read SQLite and lose it before the action closure runs.
      state = this.ctx.dirty.get(Number(tk)) || state;
      if (dl && typeof dl.sau === 'function') dl.ketQua = dl.sau(state);
      // An action at an already-reached horizon still mutates `state`; merge
      // the stable receipt and flush it once at ketThuc.
      this.luu(Number(tk), state, {mutation: mutation});
      ok = true;
      return state;
    } finally {
      this.mocTick.pop();
      this.chuStack.pop();
      this.dangTick.delete(Number(tk));
      this.ketThuc(ok);
    }
  };
  ```

  A direct
  `luu` opens the existing one-row context and flushes through `ketThuc`; a
  nested call merely stages the same `{ tk, st }` row. Therefore
  `_ghiNhieu(ds, now)` remains the real projection/write primitive, every row
  receives one post-batch `dq.revision`, and all job derivation uses exactly one
  resolved mutation context (`explicitMutation || activeMutation`). It rejects an
  absent/conflicting token before `dq`, projection, or scheduler writes. A
  continuation receipt bypasses `replaceAccountAdvance` and carries the
  post-batch revision to the writer; it does not derive a successor itself.
  A newly admitted Writer drain creates only `1..50_000`, but an already-active
  `MutationContext` may hold exactly `0` after its 50,000th primitive. World
  save/staging and same-object nesting accept that committed `0` so the partial
  checkpoint can persist; only `G.tick` and a *new* drain reject a starting
  zero budget. No caller may replace the `remainingBudget` object mid-UoW.

  Extend `taoDeQuoc(tk,hienThi,options)` and
  `xoaTaiKhoan(tk,hienThi,options)` with the same optional mutation object used
  by `luu`; both call `layMutationLuu` before their first canonical write. Once
  `taoDeQuoc` has staged the initial `dq.state`, it derives its first local
  deadline and calls `replaceAccountAdvance(leaseToken,tk,revision,nextLocalAtS,
  nowMs)` in that exact outer UoW. A failed scheduler insert rolls the new
  empire/state back; a successful registration therefore has exactly one live
  `ACCOUNT_ADVANCE` before its API response commits.

  `xoaTaiKhoan` calls `resolveDeletedAccountJobs` in the same outer UoW before
  deleting canonical `dq`: it terminal-cancels only the account's un-applied
  local wake and returns every unresolved global row indexed by
  `source_account_id`. After the canonical row is deleted, but before this UoW
  can commit, it passes those rows through absence-verified
  `invalidateGlobalJob`, which inserts each `ENTITY_REMOVED` application and
  finishes it `CANCELLED`. It never uses `cancel()` for a global row. A throw
  restores both the account and jobs; the watermark stays held until deletion,
  applications, and terminal rows commit together. Task 9's final
  `sweepDeletedAccountOrphans` repeats this safety net with a left join over
  both missing `source_account_id` globals and missing account aggregates;
  reconciliation paging cannot see a deleted `dq` row, so the final sweep is
  required after the last normal page.

  A save may call `store.cancel` only for an un-applied local
  `ACCOUNT_ADVANCE`. It never directly cancels, deletes, or raw-updates a
  global derived job. Task 4 adds the following Store implementation only now
  that Task 3's stable-ref inspector exists. It re-reads `dq` in the same UoW
  and refuses an extant exact entity; only a proved absent/mismatched identity
  can become a no-op application. Operator resolution of an exact entity must
  use Task 5's neutralizing reducer. A RUNNING global row is left for expiry
  recovery:

  ```js
  var {canonicalExternalStatus} = require('./events.js');
  SchedulerStore.prototype.canonicalExactLogicalKeysForAccount = function (
    leaseToken, accountId, nowMs
  ) {
    var keys = new Set();
    this.listDerivedJobsForAccount(leaseToken, accountId, nowMs)
      .forEach(function (job) {
      if (canonicalExternalStatus(this.kho, job.canonical_ref) === 'EXACT') {
        // The active replay child is projected with root fields; never add its
        // manual key. The account-indexed query has no scheduled-time horizon.
        keys.add(job.logical_key);
      }
    }, this);
    return keys;
  };
  SchedulerStore.prototype.invalidateGlobalJob = function (
    leaseToken, jobId, reason, effectiveAtS, nowMs
  ) {
    var current = this.getById(jobId);
    if (!current || current.kind === 'ACCOUNT_ADVANCE') {
      throw new Error('GLOBAL_INVALIDATION_REQUIRED');
    }
    var executable = this.claimGlobalForInvalidation(
      leaseToken, jobId, nowMs, 15_000, {
        allowQuarantined: true, allowFuturePending: true
      }
    );
    var status = canonicalExternalStatus(this.kho, executable.payload.ref);
    if (status === 'EXACT') throw new Error('CANONICAL_NEUTRALIZATION_REQUIRED');
    if (Number(effectiveAtS) !== Number(executable.scheduled_at_s)) {
      throw new Error('INVALIDATION_EFFECTIVE_TIME_INVALID');
    }
    this.markDurableMutation(leaseToken, nowMs);
    this.insertApplication(leaseToken, executable, {
      effectiveAtS: Number(effectiveAtS), result: {
        code: reason, invalidation: 'canonical', neutralization: status
      }
    }, nowMs);
    this.finishResolved(leaseToken, executable, 'CANCELLED', reason, nowMs);
    return executable;
  };
  function huyDerivedJobsKhongCon(
    store, leaseToken, existingJobs, liveKeys, nowMs, protectedRecoveryRootIds
  ) {
    existingJobs.forEach(function (job) {
      if (liveKeys.has(job.logical_key || job.idempotency_key) || job.has_application) return;
      if (protectedRecoveryRootIds && protectedRecoveryRootIds.has(job.logical_root_id)) return;
      if (job.state === 'RUNNING') return;
      if (['PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'QUARANTINED'].indexOf(job.state) === -1) return;
      var status = canonicalExternalStatus(store.kho, job.canonical_ref);
      if (status === 'EXACT') return;
      if (status !== 'ALREADY_ABSENT' && status !== 'REF_MISMATCH') {
        throw new Error('CANONICAL_EXTERNAL_STATUS_INVALID');
      }
      store.invalidateGlobalJob(
        leaseToken,
        job.id,
        'ENTITY_REMOVED',
        job.scheduled_at_s,
        nowMs
      );
    });
  }
  ```

  `listDerivedJobsForAccount` is called in that exact `ketThuc` UoW before
  commit. Its lease-verified indexed query is `WHERE source_account_id=? AND
  kind IN ('PVP_RESOLVE','EXTERNAL_RESOLVE') AND state IN
  ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT','QUARANTINED','RUNNING')`; it returns only global
  derived rows and validates each stored payload with the same canonical parser
  as scheduling. Each returned execution row carries frozen `canonical_ref`
  and the root's `logical_key`/`logical_root_id`; an active replay child never
  substitutes its manual key for the root key. The query has no time horizon,
  so a future exact root is retained. `durableLiveKeys` starts only with keys
  derived from current player-targeted refs, then adds every existing logical
  root whose validated persisted ref is still `EXACT`. The obsolete sweep
  rechecks canonical status in the same UoW and may invalidate only
  `ALREADY_ABSENT` or `REF_MISMATCH`; `EXACT` always remains an unresolved
  engine fence until a Task-5 reducer writes its neutralizing application.
  It never synthesizes a `-1` reconcile aggregate and never reads a projection.
  Thus `schedule`, retained/superseded local wake, and every
  `invalidateGlobalJob(job, 'ENTITY_REMOVED', effectiveNowMs)` application/`CANCELLED`
  transition commit together with the canonical state save; its watermark stays
  closed until that committed application exists.

  `TheGioi` only stages `dq`, `ht`, `hamdang`, and `hamgiu`.
  `datScheduler(schedulerStore)` and `datAdvanceService(advanceService)` each
  install one private capability and reject a different second instance. The
  current lease is held on the synchronous mutation stack.
  `trongMutationScheduler(mutation, fn)` pushes one exact
  `{ leaseToken, remainingBudget, effectiveNowMs }` object, calls `fn`, and
  pops in `finally`;
  `luu` and every state-changing domain method require that same object.
  Task 5 replaces direct world ticks once its service exists. It installs a
  private `advanceAccountNoiBo` delegating to
  `this._advanceService.advanceTo(currentMutation, accountId, targetS)`, plus
  `advanceDueNoiBo(mutation, targetS)` for the
  app command. A stale token rolls back state, projections, successor jobs,
  and the command marker together.

  ```js
        return {processed: 0, advancedToS: targetS, nextDueAtS: null,

      };

          x.attacker, giayTuClock(x.clock) + 1, null);
      });
      assert.deepEqual(x.world.chuStack, [777]);

      assert.throws(function () {

      assert.deepEqual(x.world.chuStack, [777]);

      G.tickNoiBo = function () {

      assert.throws(function () {

          giayTuClock(x.clock) + 2, function () { return null; });
      }, /local-owner-throw/);
      assert.deepEqual(x.world.chuStack, [777]);
      x.world.chuStack.pop();
      assert.equal(calls, 1);
      assert.equal(G.HOOK, oldHook);
      assert.throws(function () {
        x.world.withRulesHook(function () { return Promise.resolve(); });
      }, /RULES_HOOK_ASYNC/);
    } finally {
      G.tick = oldTick; G.tickNoiBo = oldTickNoiBo;
      G.HOOK = oldHook; x.dong(); y.dong();
    }
  });
  ```

  ```js
  function executeFixtureClaimedInCurrentUow(x, mutation, claimed, nowMs) {
    var executable = x.store.loadExecutableJob(mutation.leaseToken, claimed, nowMs);
    x.store.markDurableMutation(mutation.leaseToken, nowMs);
    if (executable.kind !== 'ACCOUNT_ADVANCE') {
      var barrier = x.service.advanceBarrier(mutation, executable);
      if (barrier.budgetExhausted) return { partial: true, jobId: executable.id };
      if (!x.store.hasCommittedApplication(
        mutation.leaseToken, executable, nowMs
      )) {
        if (mutation.remainingBudget.value === 0) {
          return {partial: true, budgetExhausted: true, jobId: executable.id};
        }
        mutation.remainingBudget.value -= 1;
      }
    }
    var prepared = x.reducer.prepare(mutation, executable);
    if (prepared.kind === 'partial') {
      var checkpoint = x.reducer.applyPrepared(mutation, prepared);
      x.store.checkpointPartial(
        mutation.leaseToken, executable, checkpoint.checkpointRevision, nowMs
      );
      return { partial: true, jobId: executable.id };
    }
    var application = x.store.insertApplication(
      mutation.leaseToken,
      executable,
      prepared.application,
      nowMs,
      prepared.canonicalTContext || null
    );
    var effect = prepared.mutation || { nextLocalAtS: null };
    if (!application.alreadyApplied) effect = x.reducer.applyPrepared(mutation, prepared) || effect;
    if (prepared.terminalState === 'CANCELLED') {
      x.store.finishResolved(
        mutation.leaseToken, executable, 'CANCELLED', prepared.cancelReason, nowMs
      );
    } else if (executable.kind === 'ACCOUNT_ADVANCE') {
      x.store.completeAccountAdvanceAndScheduleSuccessor(
        mutation.leaseToken, executable, effect.nextLocalAtS, nowMs
      );
    } else {
      x.store.completeApplied(mutation.leaseToken, executable, nowMs);
    }
    return { partial: false, jobId: executable.id, executable: executable };
  }
  function damBaoLeaseFixture(x) {
    var row = x.kho.db.prepare(
      "SELECT expires_at_ms FROM scheduler_lease WHERE lease_name='global-writer'"
    ).get();
    if (Number(row.expires_at_ms) <= x.clock.nowMs()) {
      if (Number(row.expires_at_ms) === x.clock.nowMs()) x.clock.advanceMs(1);
      x.lease = layLease(x, x.lease.ownerId);
    }
    return x.lease;
  }
  function tuaFixtureQuaDichVu(x, accountId, atS) {
    x.clock.setS(atS);
    damBaoLeaseFixture(x);
    x.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
      var mutation = taoMutationTam(x.lease, {value: 50_000}, x.clock.nowMs());
      x.world.trongMutationScheduler(mutation, function () {
        x.service.advanceTo(mutation, accountId, atS, null);
      });
    }, {immediate: true});
  }
  function apDungPrepared(x, job, remainingBudget) {
    // Store only accepts an effect application for a live RUNNING claim.  The
    // direct reducer tests therefore obtain the same lease-verified claim a
    // writer would have obtained, rather than bypassing the state machine.
    x.clock.setS(job.scheduled_at_s);
    // PvP setup begins 120 seconds earlier, while a local fixture can begin
    // one second earlier. Acquire a new generation only when the old token is
    // no longer strictly live at this operation time.
    damBaoLeaseFixture(x);
    job = x.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
      var claimed = job.kind === 'ACCOUNT_ADVANCE' ?
        x.store.claimNext(x.lease, x.clock.nowMs(), job.scheduled_at_s, 15_000) :
        x.store.claimForResolution(
          x.lease, job.id, x.clock.nowMs(), 15_000, {onlyEligible: true}
        );
      assert.ok(claimed, 'fixture job must be eligible for claim');
      assert.equal(claimed.id, job.id);
      return claimed;
    }, { immediate: true });
    x.pvpStoredJob = job.kind === 'PVP_RESOLVE' ? job : x.pvpStoredJob;
    x.pvpJob = x.pvpStoredJob;
    x.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
      var mutation = taoMutationTam(x.lease, remainingBudget, x.clock.nowMs());
      x.world.trongMutationScheduler(mutation, function () {
        x.reducer.initializeCombatSeed(mutation.leaseToken, x.clock.nowMs());
        var outcome = executeFixtureClaimedInCurrentUow(x, mutation, job, x.clock.nowMs());
        assert.equal(outcome.partial, false);
        if (outcome.executable.kind === 'PVP_RESOLVE') x.pvpExecutable = outcome.executable;
      });
    }, { immediate: true });
    return x.kho.db.prepare(
      'SELECT effective_at_s,snapshot_json,result_json ' +
      'FROM event_applications WHERE idempotency_key=?'
    ).get(job.idempotency_key);
  }
  function giaiPvp(x) {
    return apDungPrepared(x, x.pvpStoredJob, { value: 50_000 });
  }
  ```

  ```js
  function taoAccountAdvanceFixture(atS) {
    var x = taoWorldSchedulerTam();
    x.clock.setS(atS - 1);
    // `taoWorldSchedulerTam` acquired while constructing its base world; this
    // fixture's logical horizon may be later.  Reacquire after moving the fake
    // clock, before the first revisioned save, so every operation has a live
    // generation rather than silently using the construction token.
    x.lease = layLease(x, x.lease.ownerId);
    var state = coDinhTimeline(docState(x.kho, x.attacker), atS - 1);
    state.planets[0].qB = [{ id: 'metalMine', n: 1, xong: atS, tg: 0 }];
    luuQuaMutation(x, x.attacker, state);
    x.accountJob = x.store.getByIdempotencyKey(
      x.kho.db.prepare(
        "SELECT idempotency_key FROM event_jobs WHERE kind='ACCOUNT_ADVANCE' " +
        'ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1'
      ).get().idempotency_key
    );
    installAdvanceServiceFixture(x);
    x.reducer = new EventReducer({
      kho: x.kho,
      world: x.world,
      store: x.store,
      clock: x.clock,
      advanceService: x.service
    });
    return x;

  function moLaiPvpFixture(x) {
    x.kho.dong();
    x.kho = new Kho(x.file);
    // Reopen paths are migration-first too: a future schema must fail before
    // a Store can read or mutate any scheduler row.
    apDungMigrationScheduler(x.kho, x.clock.nowMs());
    x.store = new SchedulerStore(x.kho, x.clock);
    x.world = new TheGioi(x.kho, { clock: x.clock, scheduler: x.store });
    x.service = null;
    installAdvanceServiceFixture(x);
    x.reducer = new EventReducer({
      kho: x.kho, world: x.world, store: x.store,
      clock: x.clock, advanceService: x.service
    });
    x.pvpStoredJob = x.store.getByIdempotencyKey(x.pvpStoredJob.idempotency_key);
    x.pvpJob = x.pvpStoredJob;
    x.lease = layLease(x, '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006');
    // A completed job is never executable again.  Restart determinism reads
    // only its immutable canonical identity; the strict RUNNING loader remains
    // the sole execution gate.
    x.pvpExecutable = x.store.loadImmutableJobForAudit(x.pvpStoredJob.id);
    return x;
  }
  ```

  ```js
  function taoExternalFixture(mission, atS, holdSeconds) {
    var x = taoWorldSchedulerTam(), source, target;
    x.clock.setS(atS - 120);
    x.lease = layLease(x, '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000019');
    source = coDinhTimeline(docState(x.kho, x.attacker), atS - 120);
    target = coDinhTimeline(docState(x.kho, x.target), atS - 120);
    target.planets[0].def = target.planets[0].def || {};
    target.planets[0].def.missileLauncher = 40;
    if (mission === 'transport' || mission === 'hold') {
      source.lm = { ten: 'FixtureAlliance' };
      target.lm = { ten: 'FixtureAlliance' };
      x.kho.q.lmThem.run('FixtureAlliance', 'FIX', x.attacker, atS - 100, null);
    }
    if (mission === 'missile') {
      source.tenLua = [{
        id: source.fleetIdSeq++, pi: 0, tu: source.planets[0].c, den: x.targetHome,
        n: 4, diLuc: atS - 120, khi: atS
      }];
    } else {
      var fleet = attackTo(source, x.targetHome);
      fleet.mission = mission; fleet.diLuc = atS - 120; fleet.den_t = atS;
      if (mission === 'transport') fleet.cargo = { metal: 7 };
      if (mission === 'hold') {
        fleet.giu = holdSeconds || 600;
        fleet.cargo = {
          deut: G.nhienLieuGiu(source, fleet.ships,
            Math.min(fleet.giu, G.QUY_DAO_V1.segmentSeconds))
        };
      }
      source.fleets = [fleet];
    }
    x.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
      var mutation = taoMutationTam(x.lease, undefined, x.clock.nowMs());
      x.world.trongMutationScheduler(mutation, function () {
        x.world.luu(x.target, target, { mutation: mutation });
        x.world.luu(x.attacker, source, { mutation: mutation });
      });
    }, { immediate: true });
    var row = x.kho.db.prepare(
      "SELECT idempotency_key,payload_json FROM event_jobs " +
      "WHERE kind='EXTERNAL_RESOLVE' ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1"
    ).get();
    assert.ok(row, 'factory must create EXTERNAL_RESOLVE for ' + mission);
    x.externalJob = x.store.getByIdempotencyKey(row.idempotency_key);
    x.externalPayload = JSON.parse(row.payload_json);
    installAdvanceServiceFixture(x);
    x.reducer = new EventReducer({
      kho: x.kho, world: x.world, store: x.store,
      clock: x.clock, advanceService: x.service
    });
    return x;
  }
  function demApplications(x) {
    return x.kho.db.prepare(
      'SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM event_applications WHERE idempotency_key=?'
    ).get(x.externalJob.idempotency_key).n;
  }
  ```

  ```js
  test('each non-PvP external reducer makes one concrete canonical effect at T', function () {
    for (var mission of ['transport', 'spy', 'hold', 'missile']) {
      var T = 1_800_009_400, x = taoExternalFixture(mission, T);
      try {
        var beforeSource = docState(x.kho, x.attacker);
        var beforeTarget = docState(x.kho, x.target);
        assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(x.externalPayload).sort(), ['ref', 'schemaVersion']);
        var application = apDungPrepared(x, x.externalJob, { value: 50_000 });
        assert.equal(application.effective_at_s, T, mission);
        assert.equal(demApplications(x), 1, mission + ' application count');
        var source = docState(x.kho, x.attacker);
        var target = docState(x.kho, x.target);
        if (mission === 'transport') {
          var cargoBefore = beforeSource.fleets[0].cargo.metal;
          var fleetId = x.externalPayload.ref.fleetId;
          var sourceMetalBefore = beforeSource.planets[0].res.metal;
          assert.equal(target.planets[0].res.metal, beforeTarget.planets[0].res.metal + 7);
          assert.equal(source.fleets[0].pha, 've');
          assert.equal(source.fleets[0].cargo.metal || 0, 0, 'outbound cargo is cleared');
          assert.equal(
            source.fleets.filter(function (fleet) { return fleet.id === fleetId; }).length,
            1,
            'the original fleet returns exactly once; no duplicate empty fleet'
          );
          assert.equal(
            sourceMetalBefore + beforeTarget.planets[0].res.metal + cargoBefore,
            source.planets[0].res.metal + target.planets[0].res.metal +
              (source.fleets[0].cargo.metal || 0),
            'source resource, target resource, and fleet cargo conserve once'
          );
          x.clock.setS(source.fleets[0].ve_t);
          damBaoLeaseFixture(x);
          x.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
            var mutation = taoMutationTam(x.lease, {value: 50_000}, x.clock.nowMs());
            x.world.trongMutationScheduler(mutation, function () {
              x.service.advanceTo(mutation, x.attacker, giayTuClock(x.clock), null);
            });
          }, {immediate: true});
          var afterReturnSource = docState(x.kho, x.attacker);
          var afterReturnTarget = docState(x.kho, x.target);
          var returned = afterReturnSource.fleets.filter(function (fleet) {
            return fleet.id === fleetId;
          });
          assert.equal(returned.length, 0, 'hamVeNha unloads and removes the returned fleet');
          assert.equal(
            sourceMetalBefore + beforeTarget.planets[0].res.metal + cargoBefore,
            afterReturnSource.planets[0].res.metal +
              afterReturnTarget.planets[0].res.metal,
            'return keeps cargo/resource conservation'
          );
        }
        if (mission === 'spy') {
          assert.equal(source.spy[G.tdKey(x.targetHome)].t, T);
          assert.equal(source.fleets[0].pha, 've');
        }
        if (mission === 'hold') {
          assert.equal(
            beforeSource.fleets[0].cargo.deut,
            G.nhienLieuGiu(beforeSource, beforeSource.fleets[0].ships,
              Math.min(beforeSource.fleets[0].giu, G.QUY_DAO_V1.segmentSeconds))
          );
          assert.equal(source.fleets[0].pha, 'giu');
          assert.equal(source.fleets[0].giuTaiTk, x.target);
          assert.equal(source.fleets[0].cargo.deut || 0, 0, 'short hold debits its one segment');
          assert.equal(source.fleets[0].dangGiu, true);
          assert.equal(source.fleets[0].giuRules, G.QUY_DAO_V1.holdRules);
          assert.equal(source.fleets[0].giuLuc, T);
          assert.equal(source.fleets[0].giuDen_t, T + beforeSource.fleets[0].giu);
          assert.equal(source.fleets[0].tiepNL_t,
            T + Math.min(beforeSource.fleets[0].giu, G.QUY_DAO_V1.segmentSeconds));
          ['holdAt', 'holdUntil', 'nextHoldFuelAt', 'holdingForAccountId'].forEach(function (alias) {
            assert.equal(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(source.fleets[0], alias), false);
          });
        }
        if (mission === 'missile') {
          assert.equal(source.tenLua.length, 0);
          assert.ok(target.planets[0].def.missileLauncher < beforeTarget.planets[0].def.missileLauncher);
        }
        assert.doesNotMatch(
          x.kho.db.prepare('SELECT payload_json FROM event_jobs WHERE id=?')
            .get(x.externalJob.id).payload_json,
          /snapshot|supporter|defender|cargo|ships/
        );
        assert.equal(
          x.kho.db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM event_applications WHERE job_id=?')
            .get(x.externalJob.id).n,
          1,
          mission + ' has exactly one immutable effect record'
        );
        var stateAfterEffect = JSON.stringify({
          source: docState(x.kho, x.attacker), target: docState(x.kho, x.target)
        });
        var storedApplication = x.kho.db.prepare(
          'SELECT effective_at_s,result_json FROM event_applications WHERE job_id=?'
        ).get(x.externalJob.id);
        var immutable = x.store.loadImmutableJobForAudit(x.externalJob.id);
        x.store.validateStoredApplication(
          x.kho.db.prepare('SELECT * FROM event_applications WHERE job_id=?').get(x.externalJob.id),
          immutable
        );
        assert.ok(true, mission + ' duplicate path validates its immutable application');
        assert.equal(
          JSON.stringify({source: docState(x.kho, x.attacker), target: docState(x.kho, x.target)}),
          stateAfterEffect,
          mission + ' duplicate replay changes no canonical resource, cargo, or fleet state'
        );
        void beforeSource;
      } finally { x.dong(); }
    }
  });
  ```

  ```js
  test('real launch funds only the first hold segment; later shortage stays a local hold outcome', function () {
    var segment = G.QUY_DAO_V1.segmentSeconds;
    [6 * 3600, 12 * 3600, 18 * 3600].forEach(function (duration) {
      var x = taoExternalFixture('hold', 1_800_009_405, duration);
      try {
        var before = docState(x.kho, x.attacker).fleets[0];
        var first = G.nhienLieuGiu(docState(x.kho, x.attacker), before.ships, Math.min(segment, duration));
        assert.equal(before.cargo.deut, first, 'the canonical launch contract funds first segment only');
        apDungPrepared(x, x.externalJob, { value: 50_000 });
        var held = docState(x.kho, x.attacker).fleets[0];
        assert.equal(held.cargo.deut || 0, 0, duration + ' initial debit');
        assert.equal(held.tiepNL_t, 1_800_009_405 + Math.min(segment, duration));
        // G.guiHam has accepted this same first-segment cargo. At 12h/18h the
        // ordinary local hold primitive decides the later shortage; the global
        // arrival must not turn it into PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY/quarantine.
        tuaFixtureQuaDichVu(x, x.attacker, duration <= segment ? held.giuDen_t : held.tiepNL_t);
        var returning = docState(x.kho, x.attacker).fleets.filter(function (fleet) {
          return fleet.id === before.id;
        });
        if (duration <= segment) {
          assert.equal(returning.length, 1, 'normal 6h completion creates one return');
          assert.equal(returning[0].pha, 've');
          tuaFixtureQuaDichVu(x, x.attacker, returning[0].ve_t);
          assert.equal(docState(x.kho, x.attacker).fleets.filter(function (fleet) {
            return fleet.id === before.id;
          }).length, 0, 'hamVeNha unloads and removes the hold fleet exactly once');
        } else {
          var destroyed = docState(x.kho, x.attacker);
          assert.equal(returning.length, 0,
            'later unfunded segment destroys the hold through hamThanhPheLieu');
          assert.ok(Number(destroyed.stats.tauMat || 0) > 0);
          var debris = x.world.plLay(G.tdKey(before.den));
          assert.ok(Number(debris.metal || 0) + Number(debris.crystal || 0) > 0);
          assert.ok((destroyed.log || []).some(function (entry) {
            return /Nhiên Liệu|phế liệu/.test(String(entry));
          }));
        }
      } finally { x.dong(); }
    });
  });
  ```

  ```js
      var application = apDungPrepared(x, x.fenceJob, {value: 50_000});
      assert.equal(JSON.parse(application.result_json).code, 'MATCH_INVALIDATED');
      assert.equal(x.store.getById(x.fenceJob.id).state, 'CANCELLED');

      }
    } finally { x.dong(); }
  }
  ```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run barrier tests to verify they fail**

  Run the applicable one-shot RED/GREEN TAP protocol in Global Constraints.

  Expected: FAIL because current `TheGioi.danhNguoi` uses `hamgiu` candidates plus horizon rebase and `G.hash(f.id + ':' + st.now + ':' + o.key)`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement explicit reducer and barrier**

  Remove the horizon/latest-state rebase branch from `TheGioi.danhNguoi`, and make every cross-account hook (`danhNguoi`, `tangNguoi`, `doThamNguoi`, player-targeted `hold`, and `tenLuaNguoi`) return `BLOCKED_EXTERNAL(ref, T)` outside a reducer context. Cross-player deploy remains the existing local invalid-target return and produces no ref/job. `EventReducer.prepare` is total: `ACCOUNT_ADVANCE` calls `prepareAccountAdvance`; `PVP_RESOLVE` calls `preparePvp`; `EXTERNAL_RESOLVE` switches on `ref.kind + ':' + ref.mission` and calls exactly one of `prepareTransport`, `prepareSpy`, `prepareHold`, or `prepareMissile`. `prepareTransport` credits target resources, clears outbound cargo on the same original fleet, and invokes its existing return transition exactly once; it never makes a second empty return fleet. `prepareHold` follows the real launch/reroute contract: it validates and debits only `G.nhienLieuGiu(st, ships, Math.min(G.QUY_DAO_V1.segmentSeconds, giu))`, sets `tiepNL_t` to that first boundary, and preserves `dangGiu` plus `giuRules`. The existing local hold primitive debits later six-hour segments or terminates a later underfunded hold, so a valid 12h/18h dispatch is never retroactively quarantined at arrival. Unknown kind/ref/schema throws `PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY` for quarantine. Therefore no global job can be claimed without an explicit reducer.

  `GameAdvanceService.advanceTo(mutation, accountId, targetS, saveOptions)`
  consumes the exact synchronous `MutationContext` supplied by
  the writer; it never allocates or replaces its budget. A newly admitted
  writer starts at `1..50,000`, while an established context may be `0` only
  after the final permitted primitive. In that latter case the service calls
  the local-only zero-budget classifier: it may pure-advance time/production
  when no local primitive is due, but returns a zero-progress partial without
  mutation when work remains. A newly discovered `blockedExternal` is also a
  checkpointed partial even when budget remains: its exact canonical ref is
  persisted first and the command closure is suppressed. The **sole server-side `G.tick` call** is inside synchronous
  `world.withRulesHook`: it installs that world's hook, invokes the engine,
  rejects a thenable callback as `RULES_HOOK_ASYNC`, and restores the prior hook
  in `finally`, including nested calls from another world. `advanceTo` is the
  sole save owner: after `G.tick`, it calls `world.luu` exactly once with the
  same mutation and optional account-wake flags, then returns that receipt with
  the engine result. No reducer may save the same account again.

  Task 5 is the first task allowed to install full combat semantics.  At the
  head of its modified production modules use these exact imports; neither
  `G` nor match/external derivation is an implicit global:

  ```js
  // server/scheduler/reducers.js
  'use strict';
  var crypto = require('node:crypto');
  var {G} = require('../rules.js');
  var {canonicalJson, sha256, parseCanonicalBoundedJson, payloadIntegrity} =
    require('./store.js');
  var {derivePvpMatchId, stableFleetRef, stableMissileRef, sameExternalRef} =
    require('./events.js');
  // server/scheduler/cutover.js imports the same two named values from
  // '../rules.js' and './events.js' before it derives any job.
  ```

  ```js
  // server/scheduler/advance-service.js
  var {G} = require('../rules.js');
  var {canonicalJson} = require('./store.js');
  var {stableFleetRef, stableMissileRef, sameExternalRef, jobFromRef, deriveExternalJobs} =
    require('./events.js');
  function toPublicAdvanceResult(outcome) {
    if (!outcome || typeof outcome !== 'object' ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(outcome.processed) || outcome.processed < 0 ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(outcome.advancedToS) || outcome.advancedToS < 0 ||
        (outcome.nextDueAtS !== null &&
          (!Number.isSafeInteger(outcome.nextDueAtS) || outcome.nextDueAtS < 0)) ||
        typeof outcome.hasMoreDue !== 'boolean' ||
        typeof outcome.budgetExhausted !== 'boolean') {
      throw new Error('ADVANCE_RESULT_INVALID');
    }
    return {
      processed: outcome.processed,
      advancedToS: outcome.advancedToS,
      nextDueAtS: outcome.nextDueAtS,
      hasMoreDue: outcome.hasMoreDue,
      budgetExhausted: outcome.budgetExhausted
    };
  }
  GameAdvanceService.prototype.advanceTo = function (
    mutation, accountId, targetS, saveOptions
  ) {
    var self = this;
    var budget = mutation && mutation.remainingBudget;
    if (!budget || !Number.isSafeInteger(budget.value) || budget.value < 0 ||
        budget.value > 50_000 || !Number.isSafeInteger(targetS) || targetS < 0) {
      throw new Error('TICK_BUDGET_INVALID');
    }
    return this.world.withRulesHook(function () {
      var loaded = self.world.nap(accountId);
      var state = loaded && loaded.st;
      var horizon;
      var next;
      var result;
      var receipt = null;
      var canonical;
      var targetAccountForKey;
      if (!state) {
        return {
          processed: 0, advancedToS: targetS, nextDueAtS: null,
          hasMoreDue: false, budgetExhausted: false, saveReceipt: null
        };
      }
      horizon = Number(state.lastTick);
      canonical = self.canonicalRowsAndOwners();
      targetAccountForKey = saveOptions && typeof saveOptions.targetAccountForKey === 'function' ?
        saveOptions.targetAccountForKey : self.ownerForTarget.bind(self, canonical.owners);
      next = G.phanLoaiSuKienKe(state, accountId, {
        targetAccountForKey: targetAccountForKey
      });
      if (targetS <= horizon && (!next || next.atS > targetS)) {
        // A released deferred ACCOUNT_ADVANCE still owns successor derivation.
        // Its controlled save is authoritative even when no tick is needed;
        // ordinary command no-ops remain read-only.
        if (saveOptions && saveOptions.deferAccountWake === true) {
          receipt = self.world.luu(accountId, state,
            Object.assign({mutation: mutation}, saveOptions));
        }
        return {
          processed: 0, advancedToS: horizon, nextDueAtS: next ? next.atS : null,
          hasMoreDue: false, budgetExhausted: false, saveReceipt: receipt
        };
      }
      if (budget.value === 0) {
        if (!next || next.atS > targetS) {
          self.world.chuStack.push(Number(accountId));
          try {
            result = G.tickNoiBo(state, targetS, {
              ownerAccountId: accountId, remainingBudget: budget,
              targetAccountForKey: targetAccountForKey
            });
          } finally { self.world.chuStack.pop(); }
          if (result.advancedToS > horizon) {
            receipt = self.world.luu(accountId, state,
              Object.assign({mutation: mutation}, saveOptions || {}));
          }
          return Object.assign({}, result, {saveReceipt: receipt});
        }
        return {
          processed: 0, advancedToS: horizon, nextDueAtS: next ? next.atS : null,
          hasMoreDue: Boolean(next && next.atS <= targetS),
          budgetExhausted: true, saveReceipt: null
        };
      }
      self.world.chuStack.push(Number(accountId));
      try {
        result = G.tick(state, targetS, {
          ownerAccountId: accountId,
          remainingBudget: budget,
          multiplayer: true,
          targetAccountForKey: targetAccountForKey
        });
      } finally {
        self.world.chuStack.pop();
      }
      if (result.blockedExternal) {
        // The engine built this ref from canonical dq state while the canonical
        // owner map proved a player target. Persist that exact identity here;
        // projection ht is neither consulted nor trusted for the hand-off.
        var exactJob = jobFromRef(result.blockedExternal.ref, targetAccountForKey);
        if (!exactJob) throw new Error('BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_JOB_INVALID');
        var persisted = self.store.schedule(
          mutation.leaseToken, exactJob, mutation.effectiveNowMs
        );
        result = Object.assign({}, result, {
          deferredExternal: true,
          blockedExternalJobId: persisted.id,
          nextDueAtS: Number(exactJob.scheduledAtS),
          hasMoreDue: true
        });
      }
      // Schedule the exact global before saving the account. Task 6 binds the
      // resulting ordinary successor (or the already-adopted source wake) to
      // this ID before the UoW commits, so no unblocked same-T wake is visible.
      if (result.processed > 0 || result.advancedToS > horizon || result.blockedExternal) {
        receipt = self.world.luu(accountId, state, Object.assign(
          {mutation: mutation}, saveOptions || {}
        ));
      }
      return Object.assign({}, result, {saveReceipt: receipt});
    });
  };
  function GameAdvanceService(options) {
    if (!options || !options.kho || !options.world || !options.store || !options.clock) {
      throw new Error('ADVANCE_SERVICE_CONTEXT_INVALID');
    }
    this.kho = options.kho;
    this.world = options.world;
    this.store = options.store;
    this.clock = options.clock;
  }
  GameAdvanceService.prototype.canonicalRowsAndOwners = function () {
    var rows = this.kho.db.prepare('SELECT tk,state,revision FROM dq ORDER BY tk').all().map(function (row) {
      return {tk: Number(row.tk), revision: Number(row.revision), st: JSON.parse(row.state)};
    });
    var owners = new Map();
    rows.forEach(function (row) {
      (row.st.planets || []).forEach(function (planet) {
        var key = G.tdKey(planet.c);
        if (owners.has(key) && owners.get(key) !== row.tk) {
          throw new Error('CANONICAL_TARGET_OWNER_CONFLICT');
        }
        owners.set(key, row.tk);
      });

  GameAdvanceService.prototype.advanceBarrier = function (mutation, job) {

          hasMoreDue: true, budgetExhausted: false,

            String(job.logical_key || job.idempotency_key) + '|' + accountId + '|' +

          precedingJobId: after.first.id};

      // result proves whether due work remains.

        .forEach(function (entry) {

  ```

  `advanceBarrier(mutation, job)` passes that same exact
  `mutation.remainingBudget` object to every account and never replaces it.
  After every saved local primitive it reloads all canonical rows, rejects
  duplicate owners, derives and schedules every newly player-targeted ref at
  or before `T`, recomputes current participants/supporters, and restarts the
  ascending-account scan. A deterministic RNG derived from logical-root key,
  account, `T`, canonical revision, and canonical state is the only RNG in
  this live loop. Stability requires two identical semantic scans with no due
  participant. If a rescan discovers a strictly earlier logical DB tuple, it
  returns `precedingJobId`; Writer parks the current owned row without an
  application/attempt and immediately re-queries with the same budget. It
  never recursively applies the discovered row. If budget reaches zero, one
  final zero-cost rescan still persists/discovers/parks correctly, then the
  writer schedules the next macrotask without a snapshot/application.

  `preflightCutover(leaseToken, cutoverAtS, remainingBudget,effectiveNowMs)` is the no-write counterpart
  used only by Task 9. It reads every `dq.state` once in account-id order,
  deep-clones each JSON value, and runs the same local classifier and canonical
  global-candidate fixed point against an in-memory map. Its dry staging object
  has no `Kho`, Store, projection, application, or successor-job methods. It
  returns `{ processed, nextDueAtS, hasMoreDue }`; `hasMoreDue` is true only
  when a primitive at or before `cutoverAtS` remains after the shared budget is
  zero. It does not call `world.luu`, initialize a seed, change `dq`, or create
  a scheduler row. This lets a cutover accept exactly 50,000 processed events
  when no primitive remains and reject 50,001 before an effect UoW begins.

  Make that service the only server-side `G.tick` caller. In `server/world.js`,
  replace direct tick calls in `tick`, `hanhDong`, PvP/spy/transport/missile
  hooks, mail, war, Galana transfer, and `nhip` with
  `advanceAccountNoiBo`. That method reads the active mutation-stack lease and
  calls this service. `advanceDueNoiBo` enumerates due account IDs and calls it
  with the one writer budget. Domain methods receive already-advanced state or
  explicitly ask the service; they never use `Date.now()` to call `G.tick`.

  Replace the three remaining direct-tick/raw-save methods with these complete
  mutation-aware bodies. The sender account was already advanced by
  `Writer.runCommand(accountId)`; only the other participant is advanced here,
  through the same active MutationContext and world batch.

  ```js
  // `needsAccountContinuation` and `deferSecondaryAccount` are the Task-4
  // file-local helpers above. Task 5 deliberately reuses them; it must not
  // redeclare a future-task symbol or create a second finalizer shape.
  TheGioi.prototype.guiThu = function (tkGui, tenGui, denAi, noi) {
    var stack = this._mutationContexts || [];
    var mutation = layMutationLuu(this, stack[stack.length - 1] || null);
    noi = String(noi || '').replace(/\r/g, '').slice(0, 1200).trim();
    if (!noi) return 'Thư trống.';
    var nhan = /^\d+$/.test(String(denAi)) ?
      this.kho.q.tkTheoId.get(Math.floor(Number(denAi))) : null;
    if (!nhan) nhan = this.kho.q.tkTheoHienThi.get(String(denAi || '').trim());
    if (!nhan) return 'Không tìm thấy người chơi này.';
    if (Number(nhan.id) === Number(tkGui)) return 'Không gửi thư cho chính mình.';
    var targetS = Math.floor(mutation.effectiveNowMs / 1000);
    var advanced = this.advanceAccountNoiBo(mutation, Number(nhan.id), targetS);
    if (deferSecondaryAccount(mutation, Number(nhan.id), targetS, advanced)) return G.TICK_PARTIAL;
    var loaded = this.nap(Number(nhan.id));
    if (!loaded) return 'Người nhận chưa có đế quốc.';
    G.tin(loaded.st, 'thu', 'Thư từ ' + tenGui, noi);
    this.luu(Number(nhan.id), loaded.st, {mutation: mutation});
    return null;
  };

  TheGioi.prototype.tuyenChien = function (tkA, tkD) {
    var stack = this._mutationContexts || [];
    var mutation = layMutationLuu(this, stack[stack.length - 1] || null);
    tkD = Math.floor(Number(tkD));
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(tkD) || tkD < 1) return 'Chỉ huy mục tiêu không hợp lệ.';
    if (Number(tkA) === tkD) return 'Không thể tuyên chiến với chính mình.';
    var a = this.kho.q.dqGet.get(tkA), d = this.kho.q.dqGet.get(tkD);
    var tenD = this.kho.q.tkTheoId.get(tkD);
    if (!a || !d || !tenD) return 'Chỉ huy mục tiêu không còn trong vũ trụ.';
    if (a.lm && d.lm && a.lm === d.lm) return 'Không thể tuyên chiến với thành viên cùng liên minh.';
    var now = Math.floor(mutation.effectiveNowMs / 1000), ben;
    var advanced = this.advanceAccountNoiBo(mutation, tkD, now);
    if (deferSecondaryAccount(mutation, tkD, now, advanced)) return G.TICK_PARTIAL;
    if (a.lm) {
      var lm = this.kho.q.lmGet.get(a.lm);
      if (!lm || Number(lm.chu) !== Number(tkA)) return 'Chỉ chủ liên minh mới được đặt lệnh chiến tranh.';
      if (this.kho.q.chienGetLM.get(a.lm, tkD)) return 'Liên minh đã tuyên chiến với chỉ huy này.';
      this.kho.q.chienThemLM.run(a.lm, tkD, now); ben = a.lm;
    } else {
      if (this.kho.q.chienGetTK.get(tkA, tkD)) return 'Ta đã tuyên chiến với chỉ huy này.';
      this.kho.q.chienThemTK.run(tkA, tkD, now);
      var tenA = this.kho.q.tkTheoId.get(tkA);
      ben = tenA ? tenA.hienthi : 'Một chỉ huy';
    }
    this.kho.q.btThem.run(now, 'chien', ben + ' tuyên chiến với ' + tenD.hienthi +
      '; Hội Đồng Bảo An sẽ cho phép giao chiến sau 24 giờ.');
    var target = this.nap(tkD);
    if (target) {

        'Lệnh được đặt lúc ' + G.gio(now * 1000) + '. Sau 24 giờ, ' + ben +
        ' được phép tấn công các hành tinh của ta.');
      this.luu(tkD, target.st, {mutation: mutation});
    }
    return null;
  };
  ```

  ```js
  TheGioi.prototype.chuyenGalana = function (tkA, tkD, so) {
    var stack = this._mutationContexts || [];
    var mutation = layMutationLuu(this, stack[stack.length - 1] || null);
    tkD = Math.floor(Number(tkD)); so = Math.floor(Number(so));
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(tkD) || tkD < 1 || tkD === Number(tkA)) return 'Người nhận không hợp lệ.';
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(so) || so < 1 || so > 1_000_000_000_000) {
      return 'Số Galana phải từ 1 tới 1.000.000.000.000.';
    }
    if (!this.laDongMinh(tkA, tkD)) return 'Chỉ được chuyển Galana cho thành viên cùng liên minh.';
    var now = Math.floor(mutation.effectiveNowMs / 1000);
    var advanced = this.advanceAccountNoiBo(mutation, tkD, now);
    if (deferSecondaryAccount(mutation, tkD, now, advanced)) return G.TICK_PARTIAL;
    if (!this.laDongMinh(tkA, tkD)) return 'Quan hệ liên minh đã thay đổi; giao dịch bị hủy.';
    var source = this.nap(Number(tkA)), target = this.nap(tkD);
    if (!source || !target) return 'Không nạp được một trong hai đế quốc.';
    if (Number(source.st.galana || 0) < so) return 'Không đủ Galana để chuyển.';
    var tenA = this.kho.q.tkTheoId.get(tkA), tenD = this.kho.q.tkTheoId.get(tkD);
    source.st.galana -= so; target.st.galana = Number(target.st.galana || 0) + so;
    G.tin(source.st, 'lm', 'Đã chuyển Galana cho ' + (tenD ? tenD.hienthi : 'đồng minh'),
      'Đã chuyển ' + G.so(so) + ' Galana trong nội bộ liên minh.');
    G.tin(target.st, 'lm', 'Nhận Galana từ ' + (tenA ? tenA.hienthi : 'đồng minh'),
      'Đã nhận ' + G.so(so) + ' Galana trong nội bộ liên minh.');
    this.luu(Number(tkA), source.st, {mutation: mutation});
    this.luu(tkD, target.st, {mutation: mutation});
    this.kho.q.btThem.run(now, 'tiepte', (tenA ? tenA.hienthi : 'Một chỉ huy') +
      ' chuyển ' + G.so(so) + ' Galana cho ' +
      (tenD ? tenD.hienthi : 'một đồng minh') + '.');
    return null;
  };
  ```

  For a global job at `T`, the Writer's committed-claim barrier lifecycle is the sole external
  ordering authority. It queries the first eligible logical durable root by
  `(scheduled_at_s,priority,sequence,id)`. `advanceBarrier` repeatedly
  recomputes that job's participants after each canonical save, advances one
  at a time with `G.tickNoiBo`, and therefore completes
  production, shipyard, research, maintenance, NPC/local fleet and countdown
  primitives through `T` without dispatching any external fleet or missile.
  It rejects a participant already beyond `T` as
  `BARRIER_PARTICIPANT_BEYOND_T`. An attack includes only supporters already in
  canonical `pha='giu'` state; a same-time HOLD row ordered later remains
  `pha='di'` and is absent from the snapshot. The reducer then applies exactly
  the claimed reference directly, terminalizes it, and the writer re-queries
  the first DB row. A newly discovered earlier root parks the current row and
  wins that re-query before either application exists. No projection drives
  membership, no recursion resumes a
  different row, and no engine array order is claimed for the durable path.

  `prepareAccountAdvance` is total. It reads the canonical `dq` row by
  `job.aggregate_id`: absence produces the immutable
  `{ code:'MATCH_INVALIDATED' }` application with
  `terminalState:'CANCELLED'` and no state staging. Otherwise it compares
  `job.checkpoint_revision ?? job.expected_revision` with current `dq.revision`; a mismatch produces
  `{ code:'STALE_REVISION' }` with the same terminal state. The sole exception
  is a `loadExecutableJob`-validated protected reconcile wake
  (`expected_revision === -1`, `payload.reconcile === true`, and its exact
  reconcile key): it takes the current canonical revision as its initial fence,
  because reconciliation is discovering that canonical row rather than replaying
  an externally supplied revision. Once it saves a partial, its
  `checkpoint_revision` again becomes the strict continuation fence. A matching row
  takes `options.executionTargetS` when it is a safe second no earlier than the
  job timestamp, otherwise `job.scheduled_at_s`; it calls
  `advanceTo(mutation, accountId, executionTargetS,
  { currentAccountAdvanceJobId:job.id, deferAccountWake:true })` only through
  the shared service; it returns `partial` if the one shared budget ends,
  otherwise an `ACCOUNT_ADVANCED` application and normal completion. The
  service has already made the one `world.luu` call and returned
  `saveReceipt.revision`; `prepareAccountAdvance` consumes that receipt. On a
  partial it returns `{ kind:'partial', checkpointRevision, apply }`, where
  `apply()` only returns that receipt and does **not** save. On a nonpartial it
  returns the same no-save receipt, copies `saveReceipt.nextLocalAtS` into
  `prepared.nextLocalAtS`, and copies the service result into
  `prepared.advanceResult`. It does not
  insert an application or change the immutable `expected_revision`.
  The writer stores that checkpoint in the exact same UoW before it commits,
  so the same `RUNNING` job can compare its own continuation revision on the
  next batch. A separately admitted command/save increments `dq.revision` and
  is still rejected as `STALE_REVISION`; this does not weaken external stale
  rejection. It never resolves an external ref itself. For a prepared
  nonpartial global job, the reducer validates stable ref/schema at `T`, then
  re-resolves `ref.targetKey` through canonical `ht`, recomputes
  `sha256(canonicalJson({ownerAccountId,defenderAccountId,fleetId,launchAtS,
  targetKey,arrivalAtS,rule:'pvp-v1'}))`, and compares it to both
  `payload.matchId` and `aggregate_id`. External keys cover player transport,
  spy, hold, and missile only; deploy is absent. A missing owner or any mismatch returns
  an immutable `MATCH_INVALIDATED` application and `terminalState:'CANCELLED'`
  before combat/snapshot. The Writer's common in-UoW lifecycle runs the barrier
  exactly once before calling this reducer; a matching reducer therefore builds
  its snapshot only after that barrier and returns
  `{ kind:'prepared', application, apply }`. A missing stable entity returns
  application code `MATCH_INVALIDATED`, `terminalState:'CANCELLED'`, and no
  combat mutation. `apply()` closes over canonical staged refs only. The writer
  owns the effect UoW: `insertApplication`, `markDurableMutation`, application
  hook, `applyPrepared`, mutation hook, completion hook, then either
  `completeApplied` or `finishResolved(leaseToken, job, 'CANCELLED', reason, nowMs)`. A local
  primitive tied at `T` remains in Task-3 engine order.

  Replace Task 2's provisional combat-snapshot check in `store.js` in this
  task.  The reducer builds a complete immutable v1 object only after the
  barrier has advanced and rescanned canonical state at `T`; the Store validates
  bytes/hash/job binding for every read and additionally deep-compares a first
  insertion against that reducer-owned canonical-T context.  The context is
  transient and is never written to SQLite:

  ```js
  // server/scheduler/store.js gains these explicit imports only in Task 5,
  // when the opaque Task-2 snapshot checker is replaced by v1 semantics.
  var {G} = require('../rules.js');
  var {derivePvpMatchId} = require('./events.js');
  function exactObject(value, keys) {
    return value && Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Object]' &&
      sameKeys(value, keys);
  }
  function nonnegativeSafe(value) {
    return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0;
  }
  function canonicalCombatMap(value, allowed) {
    if (!exactObject(value, Object.keys(value).sort())) throw payloadIntegrity();
    Object.keys(value).forEach(function (key) {
      if (allowed.indexOf(key) < 0 || !nonnegativeSafe(value[key]) || value[key] === 0) {
        throw payloadIntegrity();
      }
    });
    return value;
  }
  function canonicalResources(value) {
    if (!exactObject(value, ['metal', 'crystal', 'deut', 'food'])) throw payloadIntegrity();
    Object.keys(value).forEach(function (key) {
      if (typeof value[key] !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value[key]) || value[key] < 0) {
        throw payloadIntegrity();
      }
    });
    return value;
  }
  function canonicalTech(value) {
    if (!exactObject(value, ['weapon', 'shield', 'armor'])) throw payloadIntegrity();
    Object.keys(value).forEach(function (key) {

    });

  }

    return crypto.createHmac('sha256', Buffer.from(keyHex, 'hex'))
      .update(matchId + '|' + arrivalAtS + '|' + schemaVersion, 'utf8')
      .digest().readUInt32BE(0);
  }
  function validateCombatSnapshotV1(
    raw, hash, executableJob, canonicalTContext, persistedSeedKeyHex
  ) {
    var snapshot = parseCanonicalBoundedJson(raw, hash);
    var ref = executableJob.payload.ref;
    var seedKeyHex = canonicalTContext ? canonicalTContext.seedKeyHex : persistedSeedKeyHex;
    var knownShips = G.SHIPS.map(function (unit) { return unit.id; });
    var knownDefense = G.DEFENSES.map(function (unit) { return unit.id; });
    var knownTroops = G.BOBINH.map(function (unit) { return unit.id; });
    if (!exactObject(snapshot, [
      'schemaVersion', 'matchId', 'arrivalAtS', 'seed', 'attacker', 'defender', 'supporters'

        snapshot.matchId !== executableJob.payload.matchId ||
        snapshot.arrivalAtS !== Number(executableJob.scheduled_at_s) ||

        typeof seedKeyHex !== 'string' || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(seedKeyHex) ||

        !nonnegativeSafe(snapshot.attacker.revision) || !positiveInt(snapshot.attacker.fleetId) ||
        !positiveInt(snapshot.defender.accountId) || !nonnegativeSafe(snapshot.defender.revision) ||
        snapshot.defender.targetKey !== ref.targetKey ||
        snapshot.attacker.accountId !== ref.ownerAccountId ||

    canonicalResources(snapshot.attacker.cargo);
    canonicalCombatMap(snapshot.defender.ships, knownShips);
    canonicalCombatMap(snapshot.defender.def, knownDefense);
    canonicalCombatMap(snapshot.defender.linh, knownTroops);
    canonicalResources(snapshot.defender.res);

  ```

  `canonicalTContext` contains only `{snapshot, seedKeyHex}` generated by the
  reducer from canonical state at `T`.  `buildCombatSnapshotV1` is the sole
  builder; it normalizes zero-omitted sorted combat maps and reconstructs every
  participant from its account revision and fleet/planet state, then passes the
  same object both to the application and context:

  ```js

    var ref = job.payload.ref;
    var defenderId = atState.defender.accountId;
    var matchId = derivePvpMatchId(ref, defenderId);
    if (matchId !== job.payload.matchId || ref.ownerAccountId !== atState.attacker.accountId ||

        ref.arrivalAtS !== Number(job.scheduled_at_s)) throw new Error('PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY');

      schemaVersion: 1,
      matchId: matchId,
      arrivalAtS: Number(job.scheduled_at_s),
      seed: this.seedForJob(job),
      attacker: this.normalCombatAttacker(atState.attacker),
      defender: this.normalCombatDefender(atState.defender),
      supporters: atState.supporters.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
        return a.accountId - b.accountId || a.fleetId - b.fleetId;
      }).map(this.normalCombatSupporter)

  };

  // server/scheduler/reducers.js — complete reducer body.  These methods are

  function EventReducer(options) {

    ).run(crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex'));

    if (typeof key !== 'string' || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(key)) {
      throw new Error('COMBAT_SEED_KEY_INVALID');
  ```

  `normalCombatAttacker`, `normalCombatDefender`, and
  `normalCombatSupporter` return precisely the key sets validated above and
  reject unknown/nonfinite game values. `preparePvp` re-resolves defender
  ownership from canonical state, builds `atState` after the fixed point, and
  returns `prepared.canonicalTContext={snapshot,seedKeyHex}`. Its application
  writes the canonical JSON/hash of `snapshot`. First insert calls
  `insertApplication(lease, executableJob, application, nowMs,
  prepared.canonicalTContext)`. `SchedulerStore.prototype.validateStoredApplication`
  supplies the persisted `cauhinh('combat_seed_key_v1')` as the fifth argument
  on every duplicate/read path; duplicate replay validates only its immutable
  bytes/hash/ref/match/arrival/seed and never reads later state. A re-hashed
  wrong revision, participant, supporter order, equipment map, target, or seed
  fails first insertion as `PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY`.


  ```js
  SchedulerStore.prototype.insertApplication = function (
    leaseToken, executableJob, application, nowMs, canonicalTContext
  ) {
    this.assertLiveLease(leaseToken, nowMs);

        executableJob.locked_by !== leaseToken.ownerId ||
        Number(executableJob.locked_generation) !== Number(leaseToken.generation)) {
      throw payloadIntegrity();

          application.resolvesJobId !== executableJob.replay_of_job_id) {
        throw payloadIntegrity();
      }
      application = Object.assign({}, application, {
        resolvesJobId: executableJob.replay_of_job_id

        application.resolvesJobId !== null) {
      throw payloadIntegrity();
    }

      canonicalJson(application.snapshot);
    var snapshotHash = snapshotJson === null ? null : sha256(snapshotJson);
    if (executableJob.kind === 'PVP_RESOLVE' && application.result.code === 'PVP_RESOLVED') {
      if (!canonicalTContext || !snapshotJson || !snapshotHash) throw payloadIntegrity();
      validateCombatSnapshotV1(
        snapshotJson,
        snapshotHash,
        executableJob,
        canonicalTContext,
        canonicalTContext.seedKeyHex
      );
    }
    var resultJson = canonicalJson(application.result);
    var resultHash = sha256(resultJson);
    var inserted = this.kho.db.prepare(
      'INSERT INTO event_applications(' +
      'idempotency_key,job_id,resolves_job_id,effective_at_s,applied_at_ms,' +
      'snapshot_json,snapshot_sha256,result_json,result_sha256) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ' +
      'ON CONFLICT(idempotency_key) DO NOTHING'
    ).run(
      executableJob.idempotency_key,
      executableJob.id,
      application.resolvesJobId || null,
      application.effectiveAtS,
      nowMs,
      snapshotJson,
      snapshotHash,
      resultJson,
      resultHash
    );
    var row = this.kho.db.prepare(
      'SELECT * FROM event_applications WHERE idempotency_key=?'
  ```

  ```js
  function seed32(keyHex, matchId, arrivalAtS, schemaVersion) {
    var bytes = crypto.createHmac('sha256', Buffer.from(keyHex, 'hex'))
      .update(matchId + '|' + arrivalAtS + '|' + schemaVersion, 'utf8').digest();
    return bytes.readUInt32BE(0);
  }
  EventReducer.seed32 = seed32;
  ```

  Define `EventReducer.initializeCombatSeed(leaseToken, effectiveNowMs)` as the only initialization seam. It first calls `store.assertLiveLease(leaseToken, effectiveNowMs)`, then performs `INSERT INTO cauhinh(k,v) VALUES('combat_seed_key_v1',?) ON CONFLICT(k) DO NOTHING` with `crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex')`, reads `kho.cauhinh('combat_seed_key_v1')`, and rejects anything other than 64 lower-case hex characters. `SchedulerWriter.start()` calls this exact seam after its successful acquire and **only in durable mode**, before recovery; the Task-5 fixture calls the same seam in its lease-owned UoW. Standby and legacy mode never call it. Persist `snapshot_json` and `snapshot_sha256` before `apply()` performs the seeded combat outcome; persist combat result, reports, `tran.khi`, bulletin, loot/debris, cooldowns, and successor jobs in that same UoW. `seedForJob` calls `seed32(key, job.payload.matchId, job.scheduled_at_s, job.payload.schemaVersion)` with `readUInt32BE(0)`; it never uses an idempotency key, process state, `Date.now`, or launch-time defender/supporter data.

  Add the complete reducer-only world hooks in this task.  They are called only
  while `world.trongMutationScheduler(mutation, fn)` is active; each obtains
  the same `MutationContext` from the stack, uses the captured effective time,
  and returns a receipt rather than opening a transaction.  The existing
  launch-time public methods retain their `BLOCKED_EXTERNAL` behavior.

  ```js
  async function assertDynamicPlayerHandoff(
    mode, surface, corruptProjection, exerciseBlockedStates, futureSuccessor
  ) {
    var T = 1_800_009_530, x = taoDurableOrderFixture(T), targetKey;
    try {
      var source = coDinhTimeline(docState(x.kho, x.attacker), T - 60);
      var target = coDinhTimeline(docState(x.kho, x.target), T - 60);
      var destination = mode === 'self' ? source.planets[0].c :
        G.toaDo(8, 8, mode === 'npc' ? 8 : 9);
      if (mode !== 'self') {
        var suffix = 0;
        do { source.seed = 'dynamic-player-' + mode + '-' + suffix++; }
        while (G.coNPC(source.seed, destination) !== (mode === 'npc'));
      }
      var fleet = attackTo(source, destination);
      fleet.mission = 'spy'; fleet.ships = {probe: 1};
      fleet.diLuc = T - 60; fleet.den_t = T;
      source.fleets = [fleet]; targetKey = G.tdKey(destination);
      if (futureSuccessor) {
        source.planets[0].qB.push({id: 'metalMine', n: 1, xong: T + 10, tg: 0});
      }
      x.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
        var mutation = taoMutationTam(x.lease, {value: 50_000}, x.clock.nowMs());
        x.world.trongMutationScheduler(mutation, function () {
          x.world.luu(x.attacker, source, {mutation: mutation});
        });
      }, {immediate: true});
      assert.equal(x.kho.db.prepare(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM event_jobs WHERE kind!='ACCOUNT_ADVANCE'"
      ).get().n, 0, 'launch was genuinely local before ownership changed');
      target.planets[0].c = destination;
      if (mode === 'self') source.planets[0].c = G.toaDo(8, 8, 6);
      x.kho.db.prepare('UPDATE dq SET state=? WHERE tk=?')
        .run(JSON.stringify(source), x.attacker);
      x.kho.db.prepare('UPDATE dq SET state=? WHERE tk=?')
        .run(JSON.stringify(target), x.target);
      x.kho.db.prepare('DELETE FROM ht WHERE td=?').run(targetKey);
      if (corruptProjection) {
        x.kho.db.prepare(
          'INSERT INTO ht(td,tk,ten,pi,thuDo) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)'
        ).run(targetKey, x.attacker, 'Corrupt projection', 0, 0);
      }
      x.installWriter(); await x.writer.start();
      var closureCalls = 0;
      if (surface === 'command') {
        var first = await x.writer.runCommand({
          name: 'dynamic-player-handoff', accountId: x.attacker,
          run: function () { closureCalls += 1; return 'mutated'; }
        });
        assert.deepEqual(first, {deferred: true, code: 'TICK_PARTIAL'});
        assert.equal(closureCalls, 0);
      } else if (surface === 'advance') {
        var publicAdvance = await x.writer.advanceTo(x.attacker, T);
        assert.equal(publicAdvance.hasMoreDue, true);
        assert.equal(publicAdvance.advancedToS, T);
      } else await x.writer.drainNow();
      var globals = x.kho.db.prepare(
        "SELECT * FROM event_jobs WHERE kind IN ('PVP_RESOLVE','EXTERNAL_RESOLVE')"
      ).all();
      assert.equal(globals.length, 1, mode + ' persists exactly one exact global');
      assert.equal(JSON.parse(globals[0].payload_json).ref.targetKey, targetKey);
      assert.equal(x.store.getById(globals[0].id).state, 'PENDING');
      var blockedWake = x.kho.db.prepare(
        "SELECT * FROM event_jobs WHERE kind='ACCOUNT_ADVANCE' AND aggregate_id=? " +
        "AND blocked_by_job_id=?"
      ).get(String(x.attacker), globals[0].id);
      assert.ok(blockedWake, 'source continuation is durably fenced by exact global');
      assert.equal(blockedWake.state, 'PENDING');
      assert.equal(Number(blockedWake.attempt), 0);
      var beforeTerminal = docState(x.kho, x.attacker).fleets.find(function (candidate) {
        return Number(candidate.id) === Number(fleet.id);
      });
      assert.ok(beforeTerminal);
      assert.equal(beforeTerminal.pha, 'di', 'handoff never dispatches the external effect locally');
      assert.deepEqual(beforeTerminal.ships, {probe: 1});
      assert.equal(x.order.length, 0);
      assert.equal(x.kho.db.prepare(
        'SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM event_applications WHERE job_id=?'
      ).get(globals[0].id).n, 0);
      if (exerciseBlockedStates) {
        x.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
          var claimed = x.store.claimForResolution(
            x.writer.leaseToken, globals[0].id, x.clock.nowMs(), 15_000,
            {onlyEligible: true, nowS: T}
          );
          var timeout = new Error('dynamic retry'); timeout.code = 'ETIMEDOUT';
          x.store.fail(
            x.writer.leaseToken, claimed, timeout, x.clock.nowMs(), x.writer.retryPolicy()
          );
        }, {immediate: true});
        await x.writer.drainNow();
        assert.equal(x.store.getById(globals[0].id).state, 'RETRY_WAIT');
        assert.equal(x.store.getById(blockedWake.id).blocked_by_job_id, globals[0].id);
        assert.equal(x.store.getById(blockedWake.id).attempt, 0);
        assert.equal(closureCalls, 0);
        var retryAtMs = Number(x.store.getById(globals[0].id).retry_at_ms);
        x.clock.setMs(retryAtMs);
        x.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
          var claimed = x.store.claimForResolution(
            x.writer.leaseToken, globals[0].id, x.clock.nowMs(), 15_000,
            {onlyEligible: true, nowS: Math.floor(x.clock.nowMs() / 1000)}
          );
          x.store.fail(
            x.writer.leaseToken, claimed, new Error('dynamic poison'),
            x.clock.nowMs(), x.writer.retryPolicy()
          );
        }, {immediate: true});
        await x.writer.drainNow();
        assert.equal(x.store.getById(globals[0].id).state, 'QUARANTINED');
        assert.equal(x.store.getById(blockedWake.id).blocked_by_job_id, globals[0].id);
        assert.equal(x.store.getById(blockedWake.id).attempt, 0);
        assert.equal(closureCalls, 0);
        x.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
          var mutation = x.writer.newMutationContext(
            x.writer.leaseToken, {value: 1}, x.clock.nowMs()
          );
          x.world.trongMutationScheduler(mutation, function () {
            resolveCanonicalGlobalInCurrentUow({
              store: x.store, reducer: x.accountReducer, mutation: mutation,
              leaseToken: x.writer.leaseToken, nowMs: x.clock.nowMs()
            }, globals[0].id, 'OPERATOR_CONFIRMED_INVALID', {
              rootMustBeQuarantined: true
            });
          });
        }, {immediate: true});
      } else await x.writer.drainNow();
      await x.writer.drainNow();
      assert.equal(x.store.getById(globals[0].id).state, 'CANCELLED');
      assert.equal(x.store.getById(blockedWake.id).blocked_by_job_id, null);
      assert.ok(x.order.length <= 1, 'global is applied once; no same-T account spin');
      if (surface === 'command') {
        var second = await x.writer.runCommand({
          name: 'dynamic-player-handoff', accountId: x.attacker,
          run: function () { closureCalls += 1; return 'mutated'; }
        });
        assert.equal(second, 'mutated'); assert.equal(closureCalls, 1);
      }
      if (futureSuccessor) {
        var revision = Number(x.kho.db.prepare('SELECT revision FROM dq WHERE tk=?')
          .get(x.attacker).revision);
        var live = x.kho.db.prepare(
          "SELECT * FROM event_jobs WHERE kind='ACCOUNT_ADVANCE' AND aggregate_id=? " +
          "AND state IN ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT','RUNNING') ORDER BY sequence"
        ).all(String(x.attacker));
        assert.equal(x.store.getById(blockedWake.id).state, 'COMPLETED');
        assert.equal(live.length, 1, 'released no-op continuation emits exactly one successor');
        assert.equal(live[0].state, 'PENDING');
        assert.equal(Number(live[0].scheduled_at_s), T + 10);
        assert.equal(live[0].idempotency_key,
          'account-advance:' + x.attacker + ':' + revision);
        assert.equal(Number(live[0].expected_revision), revision);
        var beforeSecondDrain = Object.assign({}, live[0]);
        await x.writer.drainNow();
        assert.deepEqual(x.store.getById(live[0].id), beforeSecondDrain,
          'future successor remains singular and byte-stable before it is due');
        assert.deepEqual(x.kho.db.prepare('PRAGMA foreign_key_check').all(), []);
      }
    } finally {
      if (x.writer) await x.writer.stop(100);
      x.dong();
    }
  }
  ```

  ```js
  SchedulerWriter.prototype.reconcile = function () {
  ```

  ```js
  SchedulerWriter.prototype.scheduleWake = function () {

    } catch (error) {
      this.handlePublicFailure(error);
      throw error;
    }

      this.wakeTimer = null; this.wakeAtMs = null;
      return;
    }
    if (this.wakeTimer && this.wakeAtMs !== null && this.wakeAtMs <= dueAtMs) return;
    if (this.wakeTimer) this.timers.clearTimeout(this.wakeTimer);
    this.wakeAtMs = dueAtMs;

        // all recompute the authoritative next wake from committed DB state.
  ```
