  `SchedulerWriter` uses one promise tail to serialize admitted work, but invokes
  each UoW callback synchronously through
  `kho.trongGiaoDich(fn, { immediate: true })`; no `await` occurs inside it.
  `start()` reads `store.schedulerMode()`: non-durable becomes
  `{ ready:false, state:'legacy', reason:'SCHEDULER_MODE_LEGACY' }` with no
  lease, seed, or drain. An unavailable lease becomes standby; production polls
  for takeover, while manual mode stays dormant. A holder rechecks mode,
  initializes the seed, calls
  `store.recoverExpiredRunning(token, effectiveNowMs, retryPolicy)`, and sets
  ready. Task 6 deliberately does not call a real reconcile because Task 9 has
  not introduced it. It accepts an optional `reconciler` seam but leaves it
  null; Task 9 installs the concrete function and only then runs it before
  ready and on its timer. `manualDrain:true` creates no poll, wake, heartbeat,
  continuation, or reconcile timer. Production schedules a wake from
  `store.nextEligibleAtMs(effectiveNowMs, watermarkS)` and the poll fallback.

  Schedule heartbeat with injected timers, never `setInterval`: after a successful acquire call `scheduleHeartbeat()`, whose delay is `Math.max(1, Math.floor(leaseMs / 3) - 1)` and is therefore strictly less than `leaseMs / 3`. Its callback serializes behind the same tail, obtains monotonic effective time, and executes `store.renewLease(leaseToken, effectiveNowMs, leaseMs)` in one immediate UoW. A false result sets `{ ready:false, state:'standby', reason:'SCHEDULER_LEASE_LOST' }`, clears heartbeat/wake/reconcile timers, and rejects every command/advance/drain before its closure runs. A true result schedules the next heartbeat. `stop()` and `simulateFatalCrashForTest()` clear the heartbeat timer before releasing or closing; neither uses real sleep in tests.

  Implement `effectiveNowMs` as `Math.max(lastEffectiveNowMs, clock.nowMs())`. The writer reads `store.peekEffectiveNowMs(clock.nowMs())` before lease acquire; after acquiring, every command/drain writes the selected value through `store.recordEffectiveNowMs(leaseToken, effectiveNowMs)` in its lease-verified UoW. It computes `nowS = Math.floor(effectiveNowMs / 1000)` only at that boundary. A backward clock therefore never lowers retry/lock/eligibility time or game `lastTick`.

  Obtain the watermark through `store.globalWatermarkS()`: it is the earliest
  unresolved global `scheduled_at_s`, including a quarantined root until a
  resolver application commits. A retrying/quarantined interaction therefore
  holds every account before `T`. Each `drainNow()` creates one shared
  `{ value:50_000 }` and passes it through every reducer, barrier, rescan, and
  account advance. It never creates a budget per account/job.

  On a partial result, the effect UoW commits staged state but neither writes an
  application nor completes the job. For `ACCOUNT_ADVANCE`,
  `reducer.applyPrepared(mutation, partial)` returns the `dq.revision` written by
  `world.luu`; the writer calls
  `store.checkpointPartial(token, job, checkpointRevision, effectiveNowMs)` in
  that **same** UoW.  A `deferredExternal` result instead calls
  `blockOwnedAccountAdvance` in that UoW, producing the durable ineligible
  dependency described above. A global barrier partial has no aggregate revision fence:
  it remains `RUNNING`, retains its watermark, and re-scans canonical state on
  its continuation while no command may cross its timestamp. Budget partials
  of both kinds leave the claim `RUNNING`, call
  `partialQueue.push(job.id)`, and schedules exactly one injected
  `immediate.set(drainNow)` when not manual. The next drain first calls
  `store.resumeOwnedRunning(token, job.id, effectiveNowMs, lockMs)` and resumes
  the reducer with a fresh drain-wide budget. A crash leaves that running claim
  for the policy-driven expired-running recovery path. This is the defined
  continuation/reclaim behavior for event 50,001:

  ```js
    this.timers.clearTimeout(this.heartbeatTimer);
    this.timers.clearTimeout(this.reconcileTimer);

    this.wakeAtMs = null;
  ```

  `drainNow` catches a failed `applyClaimed` only after its effect UoW has
  rolled back. It then opens one new lease-verified UoW and calls
  `store.fail(token, claimed, failure, effectiveNowMs, retryPolicy)`. Thus a
  raw-row `PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY` reaches `QUARANTINED` without invoking a reducer;
  transient classified errors get exactly one incremented retry; fatal storage
  errors set fatal status. The failure path never retries the effect UoW itself:

  ```js
  SchedulerWriter.prototype.settleClaimFailure = function (job, error, nowMs) {
    var self = this;
    if (error && error.code === 'LEASE_LOST') {
      this.handleLeaseLoss(error);
      throw error;
    }
    if (error && error.code === 'INJECTED_CRASH') throw error;
    if (isFatalStorageError(error)) {
      this.handleDrainError(error);
      throw error;
    }
    var state = this.store.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
      var token = self.leaseToken;
      nowMs = self.refreshLeasePhaseInCurrentUow('before-failure', token, nowMs);
      var outcome = self.store.fail(token, job, error || new Error('UNKNOWN'), nowMs, {
        retryBaseMs: self.retryBaseMs,
        retryMaxMs: self.retryMaxMs,
        maxAttempts: self.maxAttempts
      });
      self.refreshLeasePhaseInCurrentUow('before-failure-commit', token, nowMs);
      return outcome;
    }, { immediate: true });
    if (state === 'QUARANTINED') {
      this.log('warn', 'scheduler.job_quarantined', {
        kind: job.kind,
        code: this.store.safeErrorMessage(normalizeSchedulerErrorCode(error))
      });
    }
    return state;
  };

  SchedulerWriter.prototype.settleBarriersForAdmission = function (
    budget, nowS, nowMs
  ) {
    var startingBudget = budget.value;
    while (true) {
      nowMs = this.effectiveNowMs();
      var token = this.requireReadyLease(nowMs);
      var barrierClaim = this.claimFirstBarrierForDrain(token, nowMs, nowS);
      if (barrierClaim.blocked) return {
        deferred: true, processed: startingBudget - budget.value
      };
      var claimed = barrierClaim.claimed;
      if (!claimed || Number(claimed.scheduled_at_s) > nowS) {
        return {
          deferred: false, budgetExhausted: false,
          processed: startingBudget - budget.value
        };
      }
      var outcome;
      try {
        this.callFaultHook('after-claim', claimed);
        outcome = this.applyClaimed(claimed, budget, nowMs);
      } catch (error) {
        if (isFatalStorageError(error)) {
          this.handlePublicFailure(error);
          throw error;
        }
        if (error && error.code === 'LEASE_LOST') {
          this.handleLeaseLoss(error);
          throw error;
        }
        try { this.settleClaimFailure(claimed, error, nowMs); }
        catch (settleError) {
          this.handlePublicFailure(settleError);
          if (settleError && settleError.code === 'LEASE_LOST') {
            this.handleLeaseLoss(settleError);
          }
          throw settleError;
        }
        this.observeJobMetric(
          claimed, 'error', Math.max(0, this.effectiveNowMs() - nowMs)
        );
        return {deferred: true, processed: startingBudget - budget.value};
      }
      this.flushCommittedMetricLedger(outcome.metricLedger);
      if (outcome.reordered) {
        if (budget.value === 0) return Object.assign({}, outcome, {
          budgetExhausted: true, processed: startingBudget - budget.value
        });
        continue;
      }
      if (outcome.budgetExhausted) return Object.assign({}, outcome, {
        processed: startingBudget - budget.value
      });
    }
  };

  // This method is intentionally called only after the effect UoW has already
  // rolled back.  It must never call Store.fail with a stale/null token.
  SchedulerWriter.prototype.handleLeaseLoss = function (error) {
    this.transitionLeaseLost(error || schedulerError('LEASE_LOST'));
    return schedulerError('LEASE_LOST');
  };
  ```

  `drainNow()` always makes a fresh `sharedRemainingBudget()`, consumes the queue
  before ordinary claims, and invokes `enqueuePartial` only after the partial
  UoW commits. It clears `continuationHandle` on stop/fatal/lease loss. In
  manual test mode no implicit callback is armed, so the second explicit
  `drainNow()` in the Task-6 test proves the 50,001st primitive is reclaimed.

  ```js
  SchedulerWriter.prototype.callFaultHook = function (stage, job) {
    if (this.faultHook) this.faultHook(stage, job);
  };
  SchedulerWriter.prototype.setFaultHook = function (hook) {
    if (hook !== null && typeof hook !== 'function') throw new Error('FAULT_HOOK_INVALID');
    this.faultHook = hook;
  };
  ```

  `runCommand(command)` marks the durable mutation **first** in one live-lease
  outer UoW, before any barrier, automatic advance, or closure can write state.
  It then settles each global barrier at or before effective `nowS`; an
  unresolved future-backoff barrier throws `GLOBAL_BARRIER_PENDING` before
  `command.run`. For `command.accountId`, it calls `advanceService.advanceTo`
  to effective `nowS` before the closure. A Promise return throws
  `UNIT_OF_WORK_ASYNC`; any error rolls back marker, barrier, advance, and
  closure together:

  ```js

    } finally {
  ```

  ```js
          barrier.advanceResult.nextDueAtS !== undefined ?
          barrier.advanceResult.nextDueAtS : self.store.globalWatermarkS();
        return toPublicAdvanceResult({
          processed: Number(barrier.processed),
          advancedToS: staged ? Number(staged.lastTick) : targetS,
          nextDueAtS: nextDueAtS,
          hasMoreDue: true,
          budgetExhausted: true

        var token = self.requireReadyLease(nowMs);
        nowMs = self.recordEffectiveNowInCurrentUow(token, nowMs);
        var mutation = self.newMutationContext(token, budget, nowMs);
        var transactionResult = self.world.trongMutationScheduler(mutation, function () {
          var outcome;
          self.markDurableMutationInCurrentUow(mutation, nowMs);
          outcome = self.advanceAccountInCurrentUow(mutation, accountId, targetS, nowMs);

            partialJobId: outcome.budgetExhausted || outcome.partial ? outcome.jobId : null,
            deferredExternal: outcome.deferredExternal === true,

            metricOutcome: outcome

  ```
  `settleBarriersForAdmission(budget,nowS,nowMs)` uses the same committed-claim,
  isolated-effect, separate-failure lifecycle as normal drain. It re-queries
  the first global DB tuple after every completion. A reducer fault therefore
  rolls back its application/game UoW before `store.fail` commits retry or
  quarantine; only after all due roots are terminal does `runCommand` or
  `advanceTo` open its own synchronous command UoW. The shared budget crosses
  those serial UoWs, but every UoW creates and marks its own MutationContext.
  No savepoint or nested transaction is used.
  `advanceTo(accountId,targetS)` follows the same tail/lease/UoW path and is
  the public direct advance surface. `schedule`, `cancel`, `advanceTo`, and
  every admitted `runCommand` call `markDurableMutation` before their first
  durable write. Only the legacy-mode pre-durable cutover import is exempt while
  it is still protected by its snapshot; every reconciliation write after mode
  becomes durable calls the marker before its first projection/job/orphan write.
  Local poison remains aggregate-isolated.

  `advance-due` is the sole command-name exception with writer-owned work:
  before its synchronous no-argument `command.run()` closure, `runCommand`
  creates its normal one shared budget and invokes
  `world.advanceDueNoiBo(mutation, nowS)` under the active lease. No API
  or app closure receives a budget or calls `G.tick` itself.

  Retry math comes only from Task 2's
  `retryAtMs(job.id, nextAttempt, nowMs, retryPolicy)`: first retry is exactly
  base plus jitter for attempt 1. Only `SQLITE_BUSY`, `SQLITE_LOCKED`,
  `SQLITE_IOERR`, and `ETIMEDOUT` retry. `PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY`, barrier
  invariants, unclassified exceptions, and exhaustion quarantine. `SQLITE_FULL`,
  `SQLITE_CORRUPT`, and `SQLITE_NOTADB` set fatal
  `SCHEDULER_STORAGE_FATAL`, clear timers, stop mutation, and retain health
  while readiness is 503. `MATCH_INVALIDATED` and `STALE_REVISION` are
  application-backed `CANCELLED`, never retries. `INJECTED_CRASH` escapes only
  for the crash matrix. Every transition proves the same owner/generation.

  `logTicks` is a required boolean when supplied and is copied from the
  already-canonical Foundation `schedulerLogTicks`. Only
  `flushCommittedMetricLedger` may emit `scheduler.tick`, after its owning UoW
  has committed, with exact safe fields `{event,at,count,budgetExhausted}`; a
  rollback emits none. Disabled canonical/alias settings emit none. The first
  fatal storage transition clears mutation state before emitting exactly one
  `{event:'scheduler.error',at,code}` with a normalized code and no raw error
  text. Logger sink failures are swallowed at this post-commit boundary so
  they cannot cause a retry or duplicate effect.

  Keep claim metadata separate from the one effect UoW so fault points are real
  and reproducible: call `faultHook('before-claim', null)` immediately before
  the claim UoW; commit claim; call `faultHook('after-claim', job)` afterward.
  For a claimed job, `applyClaimed` above is the one lease-verified effect UoW;
  it first calls `markDurableMutation`, then `reducer.prepare`. For
  `kind:'partial'`, it writes the returned checkpoint and leaves `RUNNING`; the
  continuation receives a newly read row whose `checkpoint_revision` replaces
  only its internal revision fence. For `kind:'prepared'`, it uses the exact
  insert/apply/completion ordering in the code above. If insertion reports an
  already committed application, it skips `applyPrepared` and moves to the
  matching terminal transition, so game state is never applied twice. Any hook
  error rolls back this effect UoW; only a completed prior claim remains for
  recovery. `setFaultHook` accepts exactly these five stage strings; it
  rethrows `INJECTED_CRASH` instead of classifying it as a normal retry.

  Define a single writer log boundary and status shape; all internal calls use
  it rather than invoking the injected logger directly:

  ```js
  SchedulerWriter.prototype.log = function (level, event, fields) {
    var entry = Object.assign({ event: event, at: this.effectiveNowMs() }, fields || {});
    if (!Number.isFinite(entry.at)) throw new Error('SCHEDULER_LOG_TIME_INVALID');
    try {
      this.logger[level](this.store.scrubLogEntry(entry));
    } catch (logError) {
      // Logging is post-commit observability. A broken sink must not turn a
      // successful effect into an API failure, retry, or duplicate reducer run.
      void logError;
    }
  };
  SchedulerWriter.prototype.status = function () {
    var observedNowMs = Math.max(this.lastEffectiveNowMs, this.clock.nowMs());
    var aggregate = this.store.statusSnapshot(observedNowMs);
    var mode = this.store.schedulerMode();
    var tokenLive = Boolean(
      this.leaseToken && this.store.leaseTokenIsLive(this.leaseToken, observedNowMs)
    );
    var activeState = ['ready', 'recovering', 'draining'].indexOf(this.state) >= 0;
    var writerLeaseHeld = Boolean(tokenLive && activeState);
    var leaseReason = this.leaseToken && !tokenLive ? 'SCHEDULER_LEASE_LOST' : null;
    var counts = {
      pending: Number(aggregate.pending || 0),
      retryWait: Number(aggregate.retryWait || 0),
      running: Number(aggregate.running || 0),
      quarantined: Number(aggregate.quarantined || 0)
    };
    var ages = {
      oldestDueAgeMs: Number(aggregate.oldestDueAgeMs || 0),
      nextEligibleAtMs: aggregate.nextEligibleAtMs === null ? null : Number(aggregate.nextEligibleAtMs)
    };
    return Object.assign(aggregate, {
      mode: mode,
      ready: Boolean(this.ready && writerLeaseHeld && !leaseReason),
      reason: leaseReason || this.reason,
      state: leaseReason ? 'standby' : this.state,
      dbOpen: this.dbOpen,
      leaseHeld: writerLeaseHeld,
      writerLeaseHeld: writerLeaseHeld,
      watermarkS: this.store.globalWatermarkS(),
      counts: counts,
      ages: ages,
      recoveryComplete: this.recoveryComplete,
      draining: this.draining,
      wakeTimerActive: Boolean(this.wakeTimer),
      pollTimerActive: Boolean(this.pollTimer),
      heartbeatTimerActive: Boolean(this.heartbeatTimer),
      reconcileTimerActive: Boolean(this.reconcileTimer),
      signalHandlerInstalled: Boolean(this.signalHandlerState && this.signalHandlerState.installed),
      metrics: Object.assign({}, this.metrics)
    });
  };
  ```

  `stop(graceMs)` above is the sole normal-writer release path: after it closes
  admission/timers and the serialized tail settles, it releases only the token
  it still owns in one final synchronous UoW. A fatal-crash simulation skips
  that release intentionally; no later additive release fragment exists.
  A command admitted before `beginStop()` retains one structural capability
  containing that exact lease token. `hasCapturedAdmissionCapability()`
  permits it only while the repository is open, the writer is `stopping`, and
  the reason is exactly `SCHEDULER_DRAINING` or
  `SCHEDULER_STOP_GRACE_EXPIRED`; both admission and mutation boundaries still
  revalidate the live owner/generation. Lease loss, fatal/crashed state, or DB
  close can never use this exception. Thus grace expiry rejects the stop
  caller and all new work but does not strand the already-captured tail; final
  lease release continues after that tail commits.


  `taoScheduler` validates/normalizes the frozen six-key Foundation context
  before touching either module-private cache. Production is keyed by the
  physical `Kho`; the exact direct-fixture shape is keyed by its supplied
  `Writer`.
  Its cache identity is exactly `{kho,tg,clock,logger,normalized durable env,
  schedulerOptions}` plus the allowed `makeOwnerId` result. A repeat with all
  six identical dependencies returns the same bridge and writer; a changed
  clock, logger, normalized environment, base options, world, or owner for
  that `Kho` throws
  `SCHEDULER_FACTORY_DUPLICATE_CONTEXT` before a second service can install.
  Direct unit fixtures pass exactly
  `{writer,store,world,advanceService,reducer,clock,logger,schedulerOptions}`;
  they are cached by Writer, return the same bridge on an identical repeat,
  and reject a changed companion capability for that Writer. `taoScheduler`
  calls `crypto.randomUUID()` exactly once when it creates a production writer;
  that writer retains the UUID for its process lifetime. `makeOwnerId` is the
  only test ownership seam: it must return a UUID-v4 and a repeated wrapper
  must return the cached bridge only when that UUID, world, and base options
  match. `schedulerOwnerId`, `context.createWriter`, and `context.timers` are
  never accepted. A supplied exact-shape direct writer already owns a validated
  UUID and its injected test capabilities.
  The frozen Foundation object remains exactly
  `{ schedulerPollMs, schedulerLogTicks, cleanupMs }`: it is neither renamed
  nor supplemented with durable-only fields. `context.env` supplies the
  durable values; Task 8 centralizes their full validation/alias precedence.
  `taoScheduler` reuses `context.writer.advanceService`/`reducer` or explicit
  instances before creating one, and `world.datAdvanceService` accepts a
  repeat installation only by object identity. Thus repeated fixture/factory
  construction cannot install a second service. `taoScheduler` is handed to
  Quality's `schedulerFactory`; the frozen factory context remains exactly
  `{ kho, tg, clock, logger, env, schedulerOptions }`. `taoUngDung` never
  forwards an owner scalar. A test declares
  `schedulerFactoryForFixture(ownerId)` and calls `taoScheduler` with a copied
  context plus `makeOwnerId:function(){ return ownerId; }`; that is the only
  permitted seventh key. Production therefore calls `crypto.randomUUID()`
  inside the adapter exactly once on first construction, exposes only
  `app.scheduler`, and never exports `writer` or `store`.

  ```js
  // server/scheduler/cutover.js — Task-6 fresh-only body, replaced in Task 9.
  'use strict';
  var crypto = require('node:crypto');
  var {apDungMigrationScheduler} = require('./migrations.js');
  var {SchedulerStore, assertSchedulerOwnerId, canonicalJson} = require('./store.js');
  function runMaintenanceCutover(context) {
    var nowMs = Number(context.clock.nowMs());
    apDungMigrationScheduler(context.kho, nowMs);
    var store = new SchedulerStore(context.kho, context.clock);
    var token = null;
    try {
      return context.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
        if (store.schedulerMode() !== 'legacy') {
          throw new Error('SCHEDULER_CUTOVER_ALREADY_DURABLE');
        }
        if (context.kho.db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM dq LIMIT 1').get()) {
          throw new Error('SCHEDULER_CUTOVER_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED');
        }
        token = store.acquireLease(
          assertSchedulerOwnerId(context.ownerId), nowMs, 15_000
        );
        if (!token) throw new Error('SCHEDULER_LEASE_UNHELD');
        store.assertLiveLease(token, nowMs);
        context.kho.db.prepare(
          "INSERT INTO cauhinh(k,v) VALUES('combat_seed_key_v1',?) ON CONFLICT(k) DO NOTHING"
        ).run(crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex'));
        var key = context.kho.cauhinh('combat_seed_key_v1');
        if (typeof key !== 'string' || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(key)) {
          throw new Error('COMBAT_SEED_KEY_INVALID');
        }
        context.kho.db.prepare(
          "UPDATE scheduler_meta SET value='durable',updated_at_ms=? WHERE key='scheduler_mode'"
        ).run(nowMs);
        store.writeAudit(token, 'CUTOVER', null, 'fresh-only', nowMs);
        return {mode: 'durable', imported: 0, recovered: 0};
      }, {immediate: true});
    } finally {
      if (token) context.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
        store.releaseLease(token, nowMs);
      }, {immediate: true});
    }
  }
  module.exports = {runMaintenanceCutover: runMaintenanceCutover};
  ```

  `tools/scheduler-cutover.js` is a local service-user command with exactly `node tools/scheduler-cutover.js --db <same-THDC_DB-file> --action cutover`; it rejects missing/extra action values, opens `Kho`, constructs production clock/world/reducer, invokes `runMaintenanceCutover`, and prints only `{ action:'cutover', mode:'durable', imported:number, recovered:number }`. It performs no HTTP call and prints no payload/state/account data. Until Task 9, `--action cutover` accepts only an empty fresh database; Task 9 makes the same command perform the nonempty canonical cutover and adds `--action rollback`, which invokes `rollbackDurableScheduler` only before the first durable mutation and prints `{ action:'rollback', mode:'legacy', restored:true }`. Both completed actions write the allowlisted `CUTOVER`/`ROLLBACK` audit through the lease token.

  ```js
  async function doiSanSang(app) {
    var ready = await get(app, '/readyz');
    assert.equal(ready.status, 200);
    return ready;
  }
  function phanHoiText(reply) {
    return typeof reply.body === 'string' ? reply.body : JSON.stringify(reply.body);
  }
  function phanHoiJson(reply) {
    return typeof reply.body === 'string' ? JSON.parse(reply.body) : reply.body;
  }
  function skipRestrictedProbe(t, error, label) {
    if (error && (error.code === 'EPERM' || error.code === 'EACCES')) {
      t.skip(label + ': sandbox không cho phép ' + error.code);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  function taoHenGia(clock) {
    var handles = [], nextId = 0;
    function them(kind, fn, ms) {
      var handle = {id: ++nextId, kind: kind, fn: fn, ms: ms,
        dueAtMs: clock.nowMs() + ms, cancelled: false};
      handles.push(handle);
      return handle;
    }
    function bo(handle) { if (handle) handle.cancelled = true; }
    return {
      setTimeout: function (fn, ms) { return them('timeout', fn, ms); },
      clearTimeout: bo, // `bo(null)` is deliberate: production clears idle handles.
      setInterval: function (fn, ms) { return them('interval', fn, ms); },
      clearInterval: bo,
      chayHandle: async function (handle) {
        assert.ok(handle && !handle.cancelled, 'timer handle phải còn hoạt động');
        if (handle.kind === 'timeout') handle.cancelled = true;
        await handle.fn();
        await Promise.resolve();
        await Promise.resolve();
        if (handle.kind === 'interval' && !handle.cancelled) {
          handle.dueAtMs = clock.nowMs() + handle.ms;
        }
      },
      chayKeTiep: async function (kind) {
        var handle = handles.filter(function (one) {
          return !one.cancelled && one.kind === kind;
        }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.dueAtMs - b.dueAtMs || a.id - b.id; })[0];
        return this.chayHandle(handle);
      },
      chayPollKeTiep: async function () {
        return this.chayKeTiep('timeout');
      },
      chayDenHienTai: async function () {
        while (true) {
          var handle = handles.filter(function (one) {
            return !one.cancelled && one.dueAtMs <= clock.nowMs();
          }).sort(function (a, b) {
            return a.dueAtMs - b.dueAtMs || a.id - b.id;
          })[0];
          if (!handle) return;
          await this.chayHandle(handle);
        }
      }
    };
  }
  function schedulerFactoryVoiHenGia(timers, ownerId) {
    return function (context) {
      // The public production context stays the exact frozen six keys. This
      // test helper builds an explicit direct Writer and then uses the one
      // exact eight-key direct-fixture factory shape; it never smuggles
      // `timers` or `schedulerOwnerId` into the production context.
      var store = new SchedulerStore(context.kho, context.clock);
      context.tg.datScheduler(store);
      var service = new GameAdvanceService({kho: context.kho, world: context.tg,
        store: store, clock: context.clock});
      context.tg.datAdvanceService(service);
      var reducer = new EventReducer({kho: context.kho, world: context.tg,
        store: store, clock: context.clock, advanceService: service});
      var durable = resolveDurableSchedulerOptions(
        context.schedulerOptions, context.env || {}
      );
      var writer = new SchedulerWriter({ownerId: ownerId, store: store,
        world: context.tg, reducer: reducer, advanceService: service,
        clock: context.clock, logger: context.logger, timers: timers,
        pollMs: durable.schedulerPollMs, logTicks: durable.schedulerLogTicks,
        leaseMs: durable.leaseMs,
        retryBaseMs: durable.retryBaseMs, retryMaxMs: durable.retryMaxMs,
        maxAttempts: durable.maxAttempts,
        reconcileIntervalMs: durable.reconcileIntervalMs,
        maxQuarantinedReady: durable.maxQuarantinedReady,
        maxBacklogAgeMs: durable.maxBacklogAgeMs,
        shutdownGraceMs: durable.shutdownGraceMs, manualDrain: false});
      return taoScheduler({writer: writer, store: store, world: context.tg,
        advanceService: service, reducer: reducer, clock: context.clock,
        logger: context.logger, schedulerOptions: context.schedulerOptions});
    };
  }
  function taoSchedulerSpy(commands) {
    return function (context) {
      var real = taoScheduler(context);
      return Object.assign({}, real, {
        runCommand: function (command) {
          commands.push({name: command.name, accountId: command.accountId});
          return real.runCommand(command);
        }
      });
    };
  }
  function schedulerFactoryDeferred(commandNames) {
    return function (context) {
      var real = taoScheduler(context);
      return Object.assign({}, real, {
        runCommand: function (command) {
          if (commandNames.indexOf(command.name) >= 0) {
            return Promise.resolve({deferred: true, code: 'TICK_PARTIAL'});
          }
          return real.runCommand(command);
        }
      });
    };
  }
  ```

  ```js
  test('fresh cutover rolls back lease, checks, mode and audit in one immediate UoW', function () {
  ```

  ```js
  function taoUngDungSanXuat(env, overrides) {
    overrides = overrides || {};
    return taoUngDung(Object.assign({}, overrides, {
      env: env,
      schedulerFactory: overrides.schedulerFactory || taoScheduler
    }));
  }
  var legacyApp = null;
  function getLegacyApp() {
    if (!legacyApp) legacyApp = taoUngDungSanXuat(process.env);
    return legacyApp;
  }
  async function main(env, overrides) {
    env = env || process.env;
    var mainOptions = Object.assign({}, overrides || {});
    if (env.THDC_ENTRYPOINT_PROBE === '1') {
      // Internal child-process acknowledgment only. The real production
      // factory, allowlist, version guard, listener, and signal owner remain
      // in this main path; no alternate taoUngDung is constructed.
      mainOptions.logger = {debug: function () {}, info: function () {},
        warn: function () {}, error: function () {}};
      mainOptions.testHooks = Object.assign({}, mainOptions.testHooks || {}, {
        onRequestTracked: function () {
          process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({event: 'request-tracked'}) + '\n');
        }
      });
    }
    var app = taoUngDungSanXuat(env, mainOptions);
    legacyApp = app;
    var signalStopping = null;
    function shutdown() {
      if (!signalStopping) {
        // Invoke stop in this same signal turn; wrapping the call in a future
        // microtask would leave a readiness/admission race.
        try { signalStopping = Promise.resolve(app.stop()); }
        catch (error) { signalStopping = Promise.reject(error); }
        signalStopping = signalStopping.then(function () {
          process.exitCode = 0;
        }, function (error) {
          // The app already performed cleanup-safe shutdown.  Log only its
          // scrubbed stable code; EventEmitter must never receive a rejected
          // async-listener Promise.
          process.stderr.write('SERVER_STOP_FAILED\n');
          process.exitCode = 1;
        });
      }
      return signalStopping;
    }
    process.once('SIGINT', shutdown);
    process.once('SIGTERM', shutdown);
    app.scheduler._datSignalHandlerInstalled(true);
    // Handlers exist before startup awaits migration/listen/scheduler.  A
    // signal during any phase shares the same memoized app.stop cleanup.
    await app.start();
    if (env.THDC_ENTRYPOINT_PROBE === '1') {
      process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({port: app.server.address().port}) + '\n');
    }
    return app;
  }
  module.exports.taoUngDungSanXuat = taoUngDungSanXuat;
  module.exports.main = main;
  module.exports.getLegacyApp = getLegacyApp;
  ['server', 'kho', 'tg', 'api'].forEach(function (name) {
    Object.defineProperty(module.exports, name, {
      enumerable: true,
      get: function () { return getLegacyApp()[name]; }
    });
  });
  // Requiring the module remains inert. Only the production entrypoint starts
  // the trusted factory; lazy compatibility getters share that same singleton.
  if (require.main === module) main(process.env).catch(function () {
    process.stderr.write('SERVER_START_FAILED\n'); process.exitCode = 1;
  });
  ```

  ```js
    req.socket = socketNoiBo();

      end: function (text) {

    app.server.emit('request', req, res);
    req.end(body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body));
    return xong;
  }
  ```

  ```js
  function probeFailure(line, fallback) {
    var code = String(line || '').trim().split(/\r?\n/, 1)[0];
    var error = new Error(/^[A-Z0-9_]{3,80}$/.test(code) ? code : fallback);
    if (code === 'EPERM' || code === 'EACCES') error.code = code;
    return error;
  }
  function waitForProbeLine(child, timeoutMs) {
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var stdout = '', stderr = '', settled = false;
      var timer = setTimeout(function () { finish(probeFailure('', 'PORT_PROBE_TIMEOUT')); }, timeoutMs);
      function cleanup() {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        child.stdout.removeListener('data', onStdout);
        child.stderr.removeListener('data', onStderr);
        child.removeListener('error', onError);
        child.removeListener('exit', onExit);
      }
      function finish(error, value) {
        if (settled) return; settled = true; cleanup();
        if (error) reject(error); else resolve(value);
      }
      function onStdout(chunk) {
        stdout = (stdout + String(chunk)).slice(0, 4096);
        var newline = stdout.indexOf('\n');
        if (newline >= 0) finish(null, {line: stdout.slice(0, newline), stderr: stderr});
      }
      function onStderr(chunk) { stderr = (stderr + String(chunk)).slice(0, 4096); }
      function onError(error) { finish(error); }
      function onExit(code, signal) {
        finish(probeFailure(stderr, 'PORT_PROBE_EARLY_EXIT_' + code + '_' + (signal || 'NONE')));
      }
      child.stdout.on('data', onStdout); child.stderr.on('data', onStderr);
      child.once('error', onError); child.once('exit', onExit);
    });
  }
  function withProbeTimeout(promise, timeoutMs, code) {
    var handle;
    var timeout = new Promise(function (_, reject) {
      handle = setTimeout(function () { reject(new Error(code)); }, timeoutMs);
    });
    return Promise.race([promise, timeout]).finally(function () { clearTimeout(handle); });
  }
  test('external-only port-zero probe races bind, error, early exit and timeout safely', async function (t) {
    var dbPath = tempDb('task8-port-probe');
    var child = require('node:child_process').spawn(process.execPath, [
      'tools/scheduler-port-probe.js'
    ], {
      cwd: path.join(__dirname, '..'),
      env: Object.assign({}, process.env, {NODE_ENV: 'test', THDC_DB: dbPath, PORT: '0'}),
      stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']
    });
    var output = '', errorOutput = '';
    child.stdout.on('data', function (chunk) { output += String(chunk); });
    child.stderr.on('data', function (chunk) { errorOutput += String(chunk); });
    var exited = new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      child.once('error', reject);
      child.once('exit', function (code, signal) { resolve({code: code, signal: signal}); });
    });
    try {
      var ready = await waitForProbeLine(child, 2_000);
      var report = JSON.parse(ready.line);
      assert.ok(Number.isInteger(report.port) && report.port > 0);
      child.kill('SIGTERM');
      var exitResult = await withProbeTimeout(exited, 2_000, 'PORT_PROBE_EXIT_TIMEOUT');
      assert.deepEqual(exitResult, {code: 0, signal: null});
      assert.equal(errorOutput, '');
      assert.equal(output.trim().split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean).length, 1);
      assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(JSON.parse(output.trim())), ['port']);
    } catch (error) {
      if (skipRestrictedProbe(t, error, 'external-port-zero-probe')) return;
      throw error;
    } finally {
      if (child.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null) child.kill('SIGTERM');
      await exited.catch(function () {});
      removeDb(dbPath);
    }
  });

  test('restricted probe preserves bind codes and rejects spawn, early-exit, and timeout races',
    async function () {
      var EventEmitter = require('node:events');
      function fakeChild() {
        var child = new EventEmitter();
        child.stdout = new PassThrough(); child.stderr = new PassThrough();
        return child;
      }
      var restricted = fakeChild(), restrictedWait = waitForProbeLine(restricted, 100);
      restricted.stderr.write('EACCES\n'); restricted.emit('exit', 1, null);
      await assert.rejects(restrictedWait, function (error) { return error.code === 'EACCES'; });
      var spawned = fakeChild(), spawnWait = waitForProbeLine(spawned, 100);
      var spawnError = Object.assign(new Error('spawn denied'), {code: 'EPERM'});
      spawned.emit('error', spawnError);
      await assert.rejects(spawnWait, function (error) { return error === spawnError; });
      var early = fakeChild(), earlyWait = waitForProbeLine(early, 100);
      early.emit('exit', 7, null);
      await assert.rejects(earlyWait, /PORT_PROBE_EARLY_EXIT_7_NONE/);
      await assert.rejects(waitForProbeLine(fakeChild(), 1), /PORT_PROBE_TIMEOUT/);
    });
  ```

  ```js
                throw new Error('SQLITE_BUSY token=start-close-secret');
              }
            });
            return bridge;
          }});
        app.server.listen = function () {
          var server = this;
          queueMicrotask(function () { server.emit('listening'); });
          return server;
        };
        app.server.close = function (callback) {
          queueMicrotask(function () { callback(); }); return this;
        };
        await assert.rejects(app.start(), function (error) { return error === startupError; });
        assert.equal(dbUsable(app.kho), false);
        assert.deepEqual(bridge.getStatus(), {
          dbOpen: false, ready: false, reason: 'SCHEDULER_DB_CLOSED'
        });
        var cleanup = records.filter(function (entry) {
          return entry.info && entry.info.event === 'server.cleanup_failed';
        });
        assert.equal(cleanup.length, 1);
        assert.doesNotMatch(JSON.stringify(cleanup[0].info), /start-close-secret/);
        assert.equal(lifecycle.filter(function (event) { return event === 'db.closed'; }).length, 1);
        assert.equal(lifecycle.filter(function (event) { return event === 'db.close'; }).length, 1);
      } finally { removeDb(dbPath); }
    });
  ```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement operational interfaces**

  Implement a dependency-free Prometheus text renderer with exactly `scheduler_writer_lease_held`, `scheduler_jobs_pending`, `scheduler_jobs_retry_wait`, `scheduler_jobs_running`, `scheduler_jobs_quarantined`, `scheduler_due_backlog`, `scheduler_oldest_due_age_ms`, `scheduler_job_attempts_total`, `scheduler_job_duration_ms`, `scheduler_advance_processed`, `scheduler_advance_budget_exhausted_total`, `scheduler_lease_acquire_total`, `scheduler_reconcile_total`, and `scheduler_last_successful_drain_timestamp_ms`; only `kind` and `outcome` use fixed allowlists. In `server/scheduler/metrics.js`, define the single readiness ordering used by routes and tests; an exact threshold is ready (`quarantined <= maxQuarantinedReady`, `oldestDueAgeMs <= maxBacklogAgeMs`):

  ```js
  var METRIC_FIELDS = [
    'scheduler_writer_lease_held', 'scheduler_jobs_pending',
    'scheduler_jobs_retry_wait', 'scheduler_jobs_running',
    'scheduler_jobs_quarantined', 'scheduler_due_backlog',
    'scheduler_oldest_due_age_ms', 'scheduler_job_attempts_total',
    'scheduler_job_duration_ms', 'scheduler_advance_processed',
    'scheduler_advance_budget_exhausted_total', 'scheduler_lease_acquire_total',
    'scheduler_reconcile_total', 'scheduler_last_successful_drain_timestamp_ms'
  ];
  var JOB_KINDS = ['ACCOUNT_ADVANCE', 'PVP_RESOLVE', 'EXTERNAL_RESOLVE'];
  var JOB_OUTCOMES = ['success', 'partial', 'error'];
  var LEASE_OUTCOMES = ['acquired', 'unavailable', 'error'];
  var RECONCILE_OUTCOMES = ['success', 'error'];
  var DURATION_BUCKETS_MS = [10, 100, 1_000, 10_000, Infinity];
  function newMetricState() {
    return {
      jobAttempts: {}, jobDuration: {}, advanceProcessed: 0,
      advanceBudgetExhaustedTotal: 0,
      leaseAcquire: {acquired: 0, unavailable: 0, error: 0},
      reconcile: {success: 0, error: 0},
      lastSuccessfulDrainTimestampMs: 0
    };
  }
  function metricNumber(value) {
    value = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) {
      throw new Error('SCHEDULER_METRIC_VALUE_INVALID');
    }
    return String(value);
  }
  function metricValue(status, name) {
    var counts = status.counts || {}, ages = status.ages || {}, own = status.metrics || {};
    var table = {
      scheduler_writer_lease_held: status.writerLeaseHeld ? 1 : 0,
      scheduler_jobs_pending: counts.pending,
      scheduler_jobs_retry_wait: counts.retryWait,
      scheduler_jobs_running: counts.running,
      scheduler_jobs_quarantined: counts.quarantined,
      scheduler_due_backlog: counts.dueBacklog,
      scheduler_oldest_due_age_ms: ages.oldestDueAgeMs,
      scheduler_advance_processed: own.advanceProcessed,
      scheduler_advance_budget_exhausted_total: own.advanceBudgetExhaustedTotal,
      scheduler_last_successful_drain_timestamp_ms: own.lastSuccessfulDrainTimestampMs
    };
    return metricNumber(table[name]);
  }
  function renderMetrics(status) {
    var own = Object.assign(newMetricState(), status.metrics || {});
    var scalarNames = METRIC_FIELDS.filter(function (name) {
      return ['scheduler_job_attempts_total', 'scheduler_job_duration_ms',
        'scheduler_lease_acquire_total', 'scheduler_reconcile_total'].indexOf(name) < 0;
    });
    var rows = scalarNames.map(function (name) {
      return name + ' ' + metricValue(status, name);
    });
    JOB_KINDS.forEach(function (kind) {
      JOB_OUTCOMES.forEach(function (outcome) {
        var key = kind + '|' + outcome;
        var duration = own.jobDuration[key] || {count: 0, sum: 0, buckets: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]};
        rows.push('scheduler_job_attempts_total{kind="' + kind + '",outcome="' +
          outcome + '"} ' + metricNumber(own.jobAttempts[key] || 0));
        DURATION_BUCKETS_MS.forEach(function (limit, index) {
          rows.push('scheduler_job_duration_ms_bucket{kind="' + kind +
            '",outcome="' + outcome + '",le="' +
            (limit === Infinity ? '+Inf' : limit) + '"} ' +
            metricNumber(duration.buckets[index] || 0));
        });
        rows.push('scheduler_job_duration_ms_sum{kind="' + kind +
          '",outcome="' + outcome + '"} ' + metricNumber(duration.sum || 0));
        rows.push('scheduler_job_duration_ms_count{kind="' + kind +
          '",outcome="' + outcome + '"} ' + metricNumber(duration.count || 0));
      });
  ```

  `SchedulerWriter.status()` first builds raw state from its store then calls
  `canonicalSchedulerStatus(raw, this.durableOptions)`; `taoScheduler` returns
  that exact method as `getStatus`. It always exposes `mode`, `state`, `ready`,
  `reason`, `writerLeaseHeld`, `watermarkS`, `counts`, and `ages`, plus
  compatibility `leaseHeld`, flattened numeric count/age fields, `dbOpen`,
  `recoveryComplete`, `draining`, and exact
  `wakeTimerActive`, `pollTimerActive`, `heartbeatTimerActive`,
  `reconcileTimerActive`, and `signalHandlerInstalled` flags. `writerLeaseHeld` comes from
  `store.leaseTokenIsLive(token, effectiveNowMs)`, so it remains true during
  recovery or draining while the database lease is actually live and flips on
  release or generation loss; readiness is independent. `/healthz` ignores
  readiness. `server/app.js` uses only `app.scheduler.getStatus()` for
  `app.getStatus`, `/readyz`, `/metrics`, and every gameplay-admission decision;
  it does **not** re-evaluate a second copy. Thus fatal storage, backlog, and
  quarantine produce the same non-PII reason in status, readyz, and pre-auth
  gameplay 503 responses.
  It never exposes job IDs, account IDs, payloads, snapshots, seed, lease
  token, or error text.

  Extend the existing `taoUngDung` closure rather than adding a second server
  or readiness evaluator. The optional `afterAdmittedCommand` is a
  test-only asynchronous response hook: it runs *after* the real synchronous
  writer UoW has committed, so it can hold an HTTP response without pretending
  that a SQLite UoW can await. It is rejected unless it is a function and is
  never set by production `server/index.js`:

  retain the subsequent attempted close, `db.closed` log/lifecycle, and original
  error precedence exactly as Foundation defines them.

  Thus a scheduler-start failure and normal stop both make status cache-only
  before SQLite closes. A start rejection racing a public stop is observed by
  that stop pipeline and cannot launch a second `closeAcquired` owner.

  Place the optional wrapper immediately after scheduler construction and
  **before** the existing API construction call, so the API holds the wrapped
  bridge in the test only; production has no hook and retains the exact bridge.
  This edits the existing factory rather than adding a second server. The API
  call retains its real `(req,res,pathname,query)` signature; readiness is
  evaluated exactly once by `scheduler.getStatus()` before an admitted route
  parses credentials or writes state. `healthz`, `readyz`, and `metrics` are
  handled before the gameplay counter. The stop loop uses injected fake timers
  in core tests; the only real-time wait is the separately named external port
  probe below.

  Implement `tools/scheduler-cli.js` requiring explicit `--db`, `--action`, and
  UUID-v4 `--job`. `inspect` needs no further argument; `replay` also requires
  a lower-case 1–64-character `[a-z0-9_-]+` `--nonce`; any upper-case or other
  spelling is rejected before opening the DB with `SCHEDULER_CLI_INVALID_NONCE`;
  `resolve` requires a
  reason in exactly `MATCH_INVALIDATED`, `ENTITY_REMOVED`, or
  `OPERATOR_CONFIRMED_INVALID`. Open the same `THDC_DB`-format SQLite file,
  call `apDungMigrationScheduler` before constructing `SchedulerStore`,
  generate a fresh UUID owner, acquire a lease, and perform inspect/replay/
  resolve inside `kho.trongGiaoDich(fn, { immediate: true })` with the resulting
  lease token. `inspect` uses `store.getById(jobId)`, writes `CLI_INSPECT` audit,
  and prints only `{ action:'inspect', jobId:shortId, kind, state, attempt,
  scheduledAtS, activeReplacement, replacementState }`; the last two bounded
  fields identify an unresolved direct child without exposing its UUID. No raw payload, error message, snapshot, account, token, or
  full job ID is emitted. `replay` rejects a non-`QUARANTINED` source, validates
  its stored hash/schema, calls `store.markDurableMutation(leaseToken, nowMs)`
  before `store.schedule(leaseToken, clonedStableJob,
  nowMs)` with immutable key `manual-replay:<old-id>:<nonce>`, leaves the source
  row `QUARANTINED`, calls `store.writeAudit(leaseToken, 'CLI_REPLAY', oldId,
  'replacement-created', nowMs)`, and prints only `{ action:'replay',
  jobId:shortId, replacement:shortId, state:'PENDING' }`. `resolve` calls
  Task-5's `resolveCanonicalGlobalInCurrentUow` helper. When the root has one
  active replay child and that child is itself `QUARANTINED`, this root-aware
  path first neutralizes the exact canonical identity, then application-
  invalidates the child and terminalizes the source root atomically. A
  non-quarantined active child remains fenced with
  `REPLAY_REPLACEMENT_ACTIVE`. The CLI therefore never requires a full child
  UUID and never permits a sibling or nested replay. It then calls
  `store.writeAudit(leaseToken, 'CLI_RESOLVE', oldId, reason, nowMs)` in the
  same UoW; it prints only `{ action:'resolve', jobId:shortId,
  state:'CANCELLED', resolved:true }`. Thus replay creation leaves the root
  watermark held. Resolution returns an exact fleet/removes an exact missile;
  an already-absent or retargeted identity records a typed no-op. Only that
  same-UoW proof plus terminal application releases the root and its blocked
  account wake. Every action conditionally
  releases its own token in a final UoW. A rejected invocation exits nonzero and
  writes only its stable code, for example `SCHEDULER_CLI_INVALID_REASON`, to
  stderr; it never echoes arguments, payload, snapshot, account ID, token, or
  raw error.

  The replay branch uses the Store boundary rather than `getById` or raw JSON
  parsing; this is the complete synchronous UoW core:

  ```js
  var crypto = require('node:crypto');
  var {Kho} = require('../server/db.js');
  var {TheGioi} = require('../server/world.js');
  var {apDungMigrationScheduler} = require('../server/scheduler/migrations.js');
  var {SchedulerStore, assertSchedulerOwnerId} = require('../server/scheduler/store.js');
  var {GameAdvanceService} = require('../server/scheduler/advance-service.js');
  var {
    EventReducer,
    resolveCanonicalGlobalInCurrentUow
  } = require('../server/scheduler/reducers.js');
  var ACTIONS = new Set(['inspect', 'replay', 'resolve']);
  var RESOLVE_REASONS = new Set([
    'MATCH_INVALIDATED', 'ENTITY_REMOVED', 'OPERATOR_CONFIRMED_INVALID'
  ]);
  function fail(code) { var error = new Error(code); error.code = code; throw error; }
  function shortId(id) { return String(id).slice(0, 8); }
  function assertReplayNonce(nonce) {
    if (typeof nonce !== 'string' || !/^[a-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/.test(nonce)) {
      fail('SCHEDULER_CLI_INVALID_NONCE');
    }
    return nonce;
  }
  function parseCliArgs(argv) {
    var parsed = {}, names = new Set(['--db', '--action', '--job', '--nonce', '--reason']);
    for (var index = 0; index < argv.length; index += 2) {
      var name = argv[index], value = argv[index + 1];
      if (!names.has(name) || value === undefined || Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(parsed, name)) {
        fail('SCHEDULER_CLI_ARGUMENT_INVALID');
      }
      parsed[name] = value;
    }
    if (typeof parsed['--db'] !== 'string' || parsed['--db'].length === 0) fail('SCHEDULER_CLI_DB_REQUIRED');
    if (!ACTIONS.has(parsed['--action'])) fail('SCHEDULER_CLI_ACTION_INVALID');
    if (typeof parsed['--job'] !== 'string' ||
        !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(parsed['--job'])) {
      fail('SCHEDULER_CLI_JOB_INVALID');
    }
    if (parsed['--action'] === 'replay') {
      assertReplayNonce(parsed['--nonce']);
      if (parsed['--reason'] !== undefined) fail('SCHEDULER_CLI_ARGUMENT_INVALID');
    }
    if (parsed['--action'] === 'resolve' && !RESOLVE_REASONS.has(parsed['--reason'])) {
      fail('SCHEDULER_CLI_INVALID_REASON');
    }
    if (parsed['--action'] === 'resolve' && parsed['--nonce'] !== undefined) {
      fail('SCHEDULER_CLI_ARGUMENT_INVALID');
    }
    if (parsed['--action'] === 'inspect' &&
        (parsed['--nonce'] !== undefined || parsed['--reason'] !== undefined)) {
      fail('SCHEDULER_CLI_ARGUMENT_INVALID');
    }
    return {dbPath: parsed['--db'], action: parsed['--action'], jobId: parsed['--job'],
      nonce: parsed['--nonce'] || null, reason: parsed['--reason'] || null};
  }
  function replayQuarantined(store, leaseToken, jobId, nonce, nowMs) {
    var source;
    try { source = store.loadReplayableJob(leaseToken, jobId, nowMs); }
    catch (error) {
      if (error && error.message === 'REPLAY_SOURCE_NOT_QUARANTINED') {
        fail('SCHEDULER_CLI_REPLAY_SOURCE_INVALID');
      }
      throw error;
    }
    if (source.state !== 'QUARANTINED') fail('SCHEDULER_CLI_REPLAY_SOURCE_INVALID');
    var replacement = {
      kind: source.kind, scheduledAtS: Number(source.scheduled_at_s), priority: Number(source.priority),
      idempotencyKey: 'manual-replay:' + source.id + ':' + assertReplayNonce(nonce),
      aggregateType: source.aggregate_type, aggregateId: source.aggregate_id,
      expectedRevision: source.expected_revision === null ? null : Number(source.expected_revision),
      sourceAccountId: source.source_account_id === null ? null : Number(source.source_account_id),
      payload: source.payload, maxAttempts: Number(source.max_attempts), replayOfJobId: source.id
    };
    store.markDurableMutation(leaseToken, nowMs);
    var saved = store.schedule(leaseToken, replacement, nowMs);
    store.writeAudit(leaseToken, 'CLI_REPLAY', source.id, 'replacement-created', nowMs);
    return saved;
  }
  function safeCliCode(error) {
    return error && /^[A-Z0-9_]{3,80}$/.test(error.code || error.message) ?
      (error.code || error.message) : 'SCHEDULER_CLI_FAILED';
  }

  ```

  ```js

  function runCli(argv, dependencies) {
    dependencies = dependencies || {};
    var parsed, kho, leaseToken, store, world, service, reducer, nowMs, output;
    try {
      parsed = parseCliArgs(argv);
      kho = (dependencies.openKho || function (file) { return new Kho(file); })(parsed.dbPath);
      var clock = dependencies.clock || {nowMs: Date.now};
      nowMs = Number(clock.nowMs());
      apDungMigrationScheduler(kho, nowMs);
      store = new SchedulerStore(kho, clock);
      world = new TheGioi(kho, {clock: clock, scheduler: store});
      service = new GameAdvanceService({kho: kho, world: world, store: store,
        clock: clock});
      world.datAdvanceService(service);
      reducer = new EventReducer({kho: kho, world: world, store: store,
        advanceService: service, clock: clock});
      var ownerId = assertSchedulerOwnerId((dependencies.makeOwnerId || crypto.randomUUID)());
      kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
        leaseToken = store.acquireLease(ownerId, nowMs, 15_000);
        if (!leaseToken) fail('SCHEDULER_CLI_LEASE_UNAVAILABLE');
        if (parsed.action === 'inspect') {
          var inspected = store.inspectLogicalJob(leaseToken, parsed.jobId, nowMs);
          if (!inspected) fail('SCHEDULER_CLI_JOB_NOT_FOUND');
          var found = inspected.root, child = inspected.activeChild;
          store.writeAudit(leaseToken, 'CLI_INSPECT', found.id, 'read', nowMs);
          output = {action: 'inspect', jobId: shortId(found.id), kind: found.kind,
            state: found.state, attempt: Number(found.attempt),
            scheduledAtS: Number(found.scheduled_at_s),
            activeReplacement: child ? shortId(child.id) : null,
            replacementState: child ? child.state : null};
        } else if (parsed.action === 'replay') {
          var saved = replayQuarantined(store, leaseToken, parsed.jobId, parsed.nonce, nowMs);
          output = {action: 'replay', jobId: shortId(parsed.jobId), replacement: shortId(saved.id), state: 'PENDING'};
        } else {
          var mutation = {leaseToken: leaseToken, remainingBudget: {value: 1},
            effectiveNowMs: nowMs};
          var resolution = world.trongMutationScheduler(mutation, function () {
            var resolved = resolveCanonicalGlobalInCurrentUow({
              store: store, reducer: reducer, mutation: mutation,
              leaseToken: leaseToken, nowMs: nowMs, lockMs: 15_000
            }, parsed.jobId, parsed.reason, {rootMustBeQuarantined: true,
              detail: {domainReason: 'OPERATOR_INVALIDATED', message: ''}});
            store.writeAudit(
              leaseToken, 'CLI_RESOLVE', parsed.jobId, parsed.reason, nowMs
            );
            return resolved;
          });
          output = {action: 'resolve', jobId: shortId(resolution.logicalRootId),
            state: 'CANCELLED', resolved: true,
            neutralization: resolution.neutralization};
        }
      }, {immediate: true});
      return {exitCode: 0, stdout: JSON.stringify(output) + '\n', stderr: ''};
    } catch (error) {
      return {exitCode: 1, stdout: '', stderr: safeCliCode(error) + '\n'};
    } finally {
      if (store && leaseToken && kho) {
        try {
          kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
            store.releaseLease(leaseToken, nowMs);
          }, {immediate: true});
        } catch (releaseError) { void releaseError; }
      }
      if (kho) {
        try { kho.dong(); } catch (closeError) { void closeError; }
      }
    }
  }
  function main(argv, io) {
    var result = runCli(argv, io && io.dependencies);
    (result.exitCode === 0 ? io.stdout : io.stderr).write(result.exitCode === 0 ? result.stdout : result.stderr);
    return result.exitCode;
  }
  module.exports = {parseCliArgs: parseCliArgs, replayQuarantined: replayQuarantined, runCli: runCli, main: main};
  if (require.main === module) process.exitCode = main(process.argv.slice(2), process);
  ```

  `tools/scheduler-port-probe.js` is the sole **Task-8** socket/spawn helper.
  It is not included in normal package scripts and contains no gameplay
  assertion; all Task-8 functional scheduler tests stay socketless and use
  `taoHenGia`. Task 10 separately owns its one SIGTERM child-process fault
  probe:

  ```js
  'use strict';
  var {taoClock} = require('../server/clock.js');
  var {Kho} = require('../server/db.js');
  var {taoUngDung} = require('../server/app.js');
  var {taoScheduler} = require('../server/scheduler/index.js');
  var {runMaintenanceCutover} = require('../server/scheduler/cutover.js');
  var silentProbeLogger = {debug: function () {}, info: function () {},
    warn: function () {}, error: function () {}};
  async function main() {
    var dbPath = process.env.THDC_DB;
    if (!dbPath) throw new Error('THDC_DB_REQUIRED');
    var clock = taoClock(), kho = new Kho(dbPath);
    try {
      runMaintenanceCutover({kho: kho, clock: clock,
        ownerId: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000085'});
    } finally { kho.dong(); }
    var holdProtocol = process.env.THDC_PROBE_TRACK_REQUEST === '1';
    var app = taoUngDung({env: process.env, dbPath: dbPath, port: Number(process.env.PORT),
      clock: clock, schedulerFactory: taoScheduler, logger: silentProbeLogger,
      testHooks: holdProtocol ? {onRequestTracked: function () {
        process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({event: 'request-tracked'}) + '\n');
      }} : undefined});
    var signal = new Promise(function (resolve) { process.once('SIGTERM', resolve); });
    await app.start();
    // Install the signal waiter before the sole readiness protocol line so a
    // parent cannot signal in the write/listener gap.
    process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({port: app.server.address().port}) + '\n');
    await signal;
    await app.stop();
  }
  main().then(function () { process.exitCode = 0; }).catch(function (error) {
    process.stderr.write((error && error.code || 'PORT_PROBE_FAILED') + '\n');
    process.exitCode = 1;
  });
  ```

  `resolveDurableSchedulerOptions(baseSchedulerOptions, env)` is defined in
  Task 6 because the factory and Task-7 fake-timer writer helper must normalize

  durable values, never returns renamed public `pollMs`/`logTicks`, and enforces

  The complete `taoScheduler` construction in Task 6 already calls this
  resolver before its `WeakMap` lookup, stores normalized `durable` values in

  a second construction block here. Add the final module exports at the end of


  Foundation remains the only resolver of the shared database path:
  `options.dbPath || env.THDC_DB || path.join(rootDir, 'server', 'data',
  'thdc.db')`. Add the following production-only validator in
  `server/scheduler/index.js`; it validates that already-selected path and
  never substitutes a second database path or changes the `rootDir` seam.
  Deployment passes an absolute `options.dbPathAllowlist`; a development test
  database remains usable without that production allowlist. The check runs
  before SQLite opens; a newly created production file is immediately chmodded
  and rechecked.

  ```js
  var fs = require('node:fs');
  var path = require('node:path');
  function assertPrivateOwner(stat, code) {
    if (typeof process.getuid === 'function' && stat.uid !== process.getuid()) {
      throw new Error(code + '_OWNER_INVALID');
    }
    if ((stat.mode & 0o077) !== 0) throw new Error(code + '_MODE_INSECURE');
  }
  function validateProductionDatabasePath(dbPath, options) {
    options = options || {};
    var production = options.production === true || options.nodeEnv === 'production';
    if (production && dbPath === ':memory:') throw new Error('THDC_DB_MEMORY_FORBIDDEN');
    if (!production) return dbPath;
    var resolved = path.resolve(dbPath);
    if (!Array.isArray(options.dbPathAllowlist) || options.dbPathAllowlist.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('THDC_DB_ALLOWLIST_REQUIRED');
    }
    var allowlist = options.dbPathAllowlist.map(function (entry) {
      if (typeof entry !== 'string' || !path.isAbsolute(entry)) {
        throw new Error('THDC_DB_ALLOWLIST_INVALID');
      }
      return path.resolve(entry);
    });
    if (allowlist.indexOf(resolved) === -1) throw new Error('THDC_DB_NOT_ALLOWLISTED');
    var parent = fs.statSync(path.dirname(resolved));
    assertPrivateOwner(parent, 'THDC_DB_PARENT');
    if (!fs.existsSync(resolved)) {
      // Create before `new Kho`, request the least-permissive mode explicitly,
      // then verify it rather than trusting process umask.
      var fd = fs.openSync(resolved, 'wx', 0o600);
      fs.closeSync(fd);
      fs.chmodSync(resolved, 0o600);
    }
    assertPrivateOwner(fs.statSync(resolved), 'THDC_DB');
    return resolved;
  }
  ```

  `server/index.js::taoUngDungSanXuat(env, overrides)` is the trusted production
  entrypoint factory (and is exported only so the socketless test can exercise
  the exact production validation). In `NODE_ENV=production`
  it parses `THDC_DB_ALLOWLIST` as a nonempty comma-separated list of absolute
  paths, rejects an empty/relative entry with `THDC_DB_ALLOWLIST_REQUIRED` or
  `THDC_DB_ALLOWLIST_INVALID`, and passes that array as `dbPathAllowlist` to
  `taoUngDung`; it never derives an allowlist from `THDC_DB`. The factory
  resolves `dbPath` through its frozen Foundation expression, then calls
  `validateProductionDatabasePath(dbPath, { production,
  nodeEnv:env.NODE_ENV, dbPathAllowlist:options.dbPathAllowlist })` before it
  constructs `Kho`. The entrypoint helper is concrete:

  ```js
  var path = require('node:path');
  var {
    taoScheduler,
    validateProductionDatabasePath
  } = require('./scheduler/index.js');
  function trustedDbAllowlist(env) {
    if (env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') return undefined;
    if (typeof env.THDC_DB_ALLOWLIST !== 'string' || env.THDC_DB_ALLOWLIST.trim() === '') {
      throw new Error('THDC_DB_ALLOWLIST_REQUIRED');
    }
    return env.THDC_DB_ALLOWLIST.split(',').map(function (entry) {
      var value = entry.trim();
      if (!path.isAbsolute(value)) throw new Error('THDC_DB_ALLOWLIST_INVALID');
      return value;
    });
  }
  function selectedDbPath(env, overrides) {
    var options = overrides || {};
    var rootDir = options.rootDir || path.join(__dirname, '..');
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(options, 'dbPath')) return options.dbPath;
    if (env.THDC_DB !== undefined) return env.THDC_DB;
    return path.join(rootDir, 'server', 'data', 'thdc.db');
  }
  function taoUngDungSanXuat(env, overrides) {
    env = env || process.env;
    var options = overrides || {};
    var dbPathAllowlist = trustedDbAllowlist(env);
    var dbPath = validateProductionDatabasePath(selectedDbPath(env, options), {
      production: env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
      nodeEnv: env.NODE_ENV,
      dbPathAllowlist: dbPathAllowlist
    });
    return taoUngDung(Object.assign({}, options, {
      env: env,
      dbPath: dbPath,
      schedulerFactory: options.schedulerFactory || taoScheduler,
      dbPathAllowlist: dbPathAllowlist
    }));
  }
  // `require.main` creates this one factory instance and installs the Task-7
  // signal lifecycle around it. Tests call the exported factory directly, so
  // fail-closed validation never requires a second child process.
  module.exports.taoUngDungSanXuat = taoUngDungSanXuat;
  ```

  For a new production file it executes
  `fs.chmodSync(dbPath, 0o600)` then re-runs this validator before migration.
  It never logs an absolute database path, owner, or permission bits.

  Keep `resolveDurableSchedulerOptions` pure. Foundation continues to own its
  one scrubbed deprecated-alias warning and the precedence of `tickMs`,
  `THDC_NHIP`, and `THDC_AM`; scheduler code neither duplicates nor suppresses
  it. `taoScheduler` uses the just-defined resolver before cache lookup and
  passes `durable.schedulerPollMs`/`durable.schedulerLogTicks` only to the
  internal Writer fields `pollMs`/`logTicks`; the public Foundation object
  remains unchanged. This validation happens before a writer/listener becomes
  ready without reviving a second Foundation option interface.

  `stop(graceMs)` uses the `durableOptions.shutdownGraceMs` normalized once at
  factory construction when `graceMs` is absent; an explicit override uses
  `inRange('graceMs', graceMs, 1000, 60000)`. It switches to draining, rejects new
  gameplay admission, calls `server.close(callback)`, and invokes the private
  real-writer `_beginStop()` seam at t0 to close scheduler readiness and wake
  timers without moving Foundation's observable `scheduler.stop` event. It
  waits for the close callback and in-flight HTTP count through that exact
  grace period, then preserves the existing cleanup order `wait.inflight ->
  wait.uow -> scheduler.stop -> timer.clear -> db.close`. Track every accepted
  request with a `finally` decrement. At grace
  expiry, destroy remaining sockets and wait for their handlers to settle;
  before SQLite closes, `SchedulerWriter.stop` performs the Task-6
  `store.releaseLease(this.leaseToken, releaseNowMs)` conditional
  owner-plus-generation call in its final immediate UoW. It never deletes or
  expires a newer lease, and an already-lost token merely returns `false`. A
  UoW has no `await` and therefore cannot be force-rolled back from shutdown:
  `stop()` must call `await kho.choRanh()` after the in-flight HTTP handlers and
  before closing SQLite; it never reads a private/nonexistent unit-of-work field. A
  thrown UoW has already rolled itself back synchronously before the event loop
  can enter shutdown.

  ```js
  function seedCutoverRunningGlobal(x, scheduledAtS, lockedUntilMs, lock) {
    var attacker = docState(x.kho, x.attacker);
    attacker.fleets[0].den_t = scheduledAtS;
    x.kho.q.dqLuuState.run(JSON.stringify(attacker), x.context.cutoverAtS, x.attacker);
    var input = deriveExternalJobs(x.attacker, attacker, function () {
      return x.target;
    })[0];
    var claimed = x.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
      var saved = x.store.schedule(x.leaseToken, input, x.clock.nowMs());
      return x.store.claimForResolution(
        x.leaseToken, saved.id, x.clock.nowMs(), 15_000, {onlyEligible: true}
      );
    }, {immediate: true});
    lock = lock || {ownerId: x.leaseToken.ownerId, generation: x.leaseToken.generation};
    x.kho.db.prepare(
      "UPDATE event_jobs SET locked_by=?,locked_generation=?,locked_until_ms=? " +
      'WHERE id=?'
    ).run(lock.ownerId, lock.generation, lockedUntilMs, claimed.id);
    return x.store.getById(claimed.id);
  }
  function seedCutoverRunningAccount(x, scheduledAtS, lockedUntilMs, lock) {
    var row = x.kho.q.dqGet.get(x.attacker);
    var job = x.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
      return x.store.schedule(x.leaseToken, {
        kind: 'ACCOUNT_ADVANCE', scheduledAtS: scheduledAtS, priority: 100,
        idempotencyKey: 'cutover-running-account:' + scheduledAtS,
        aggregateType: 'account', aggregateId: String(x.attacker),
        expectedRevision: Number(row.revision), sourceAccountId: x.attacker,
        maxAttempts: 8,
        payload: {schemaVersion: 1, accountId: x.attacker, nextLocalAtS: scheduledAtS}
      }, x.clock.nowMs());
    }, {immediate: true});
    x.kho.db.prepare(
      "UPDATE event_jobs SET state='RUNNING',locked_by=?,locked_generation=?,locked_until_ms=? " +
      'WHERE id=?'
    ).run(lock.ownerId, lock.generation, lockedUntilMs, job.id);
    return x.store.getById(job.id);
  }
  ```

  ```js
  test('normal drain promotes one replay child and atomically resolves its logical root', async function () {
    var T = 1_800_021_625;
    var x = taoCutoverFixture({overdueArrivalS: null, cutoverAtS: T});
    try {
      chayCutoverFixture(x);
      var root = x.kho.db.prepare(
        "SELECT * FROM event_jobs WHERE kind='PVP_RESOLVE' ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1"
      ).get();
      x.kho.db.prepare(
        "UPDATE event_jobs SET state='QUARANTINED',quarantined_at_ms=?," +
        "error_code='PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY' WHERE id=?"
      ).run(x.clock.nowMs(), root.id);
      var lease = layLease(x, '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000091');
      var child = x.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
        var saved = scheduleReplayFixture(x.store, lease, root, 'logical-root-1', x.clock.nowMs());
        assert.throws(function () {
          scheduleReplayFixture(x.store, lease, root, 'logical-root-2', x.clock.nowMs());
        }, /REPLAY_SOURCE_ALREADY_HAS_REPLACEMENT/);
        assert.throws(function () {
          scheduleReplayFixture(x.store, lease, saved, 'nested', x.clock.nowMs());
        }, /REPLAY_SOURCE_INVALID/);
        assert.equal(x.store.listBarrierJobsAtOrBefore(
          lease, Number(root.scheduled_at_s), x.clock.nowMs()
        )[0].id, saved.id);
        x.store.releaseLease(lease, x.clock.nowMs());
        return saved;
      }, {immediate: true});
      x.clock.setS(Number(root.scheduled_at_s));
      x.kho.db.prepare(
        "UPDATE event_jobs SET state='RETRY_WAIT',retry_at_ms=?,updated_at_ms=? WHERE id=?"
      ).run(x.clock.nowMs() + 1_000, x.clock.nowMs(), child.id);
      await x.writer.start();
      await x.writer.drainNow();
      assert.equal(x.store.getById(child.id).state, 'RETRY_WAIT');
      assert.equal(x.store.globalWatermarkS(), Number(root.scheduled_at_s));
      x.clock.advanceMs(1_000);
      await x.writer.drainNow();
      var terminalChild = x.store.getById(child.id);
      var terminalRoot = x.store.getById(root.id);
      assert.ok(['COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'].includes(terminalChild.state));
      assert.equal(terminalRoot.state, 'CANCELLED');
      assert.equal(terminalRoot.cancel_reason, 'RESOLVED_BY_REPLAY');
      assert.equal(terminalRoot.resolved_by_job_id, child.id);
      var application = x.kho.db.prepare(
        'SELECT job_id,resolves_job_id FROM event_applications WHERE job_id=?'
      ).get(child.id);
      assert.deepEqual(application, {job_id: child.id, resolves_job_id: root.id});
      assert.equal(x.kho.db.prepare(
        'SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM event_applications WHERE job_id=?'
      ).get(root.id).n, 0);
      assert.equal(x.store.globalWatermarkS(), null);
    } finally { await x.writer.stop(100); x.dong(); }
  });
  ```

  ```js
  test('deleted-source sweep retains a live RUNNING replay child until expiry recovery', function () {
    var T = 1_800_021_675;
    var x = taoCutoverFixture({overdueArrivalS: null, cutoverAtS: T});
    try {
      chayCutoverFixture(x);
      var root = x.kho.db.prepare(
        "SELECT * FROM event_jobs WHERE kind='PVP_RESOLVE' AND source_account_id=? " +
        'ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1'
      ).get(x.attacker);
      x.kho.db.prepare(
        "UPDATE event_jobs SET state='QUARANTINED',quarantined_at_ms=? WHERE id=?"
      ).run(x.clock.nowMs(), root.id);
      var lease = layLease(x, '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000093');
      var child = x.kho.trongGiaoDich(function () {
        var replacement = scheduleReplayFixture(
          x.store, lease, x.store.getById(root.id), 'deleted-running-child', x.clock.nowMs()
        );
        return x.store.claimForResolution(
          lease, replacement.id, x.clock.nowMs(), 15_000,
          {onlyEligible: true, nowS: T}
        );
      }, {immediate: true});
      x.kho.db.prepare('DELETE FROM dq WHERE tk=?').run(x.attacker);
      var markerBefore = x.kho.db.prepare(
        "SELECT value FROM scheduler_meta WHERE key='durable_first_mutation_at_ms'"
      ).get();
      assert.throws(function () {
        reconcileCanonicalState({
          kho: x.kho, store: x.store, world: x.world, clock: x.clock,
          leaseToken: lease, pageSize: 1
        });
      }, /RECONCILE_UNRESOLVED_CANONICAL_ROWS/);
      assert.equal(x.store.getById(child.id).state, 'RUNNING');
      assert.equal(x.store.getById(root.id).state, 'QUARANTINED');
      assert.equal(x.kho.db.prepare(
        'SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM event_applications WHERE job_id IN (?,?)'
      ).get(root.id, child.id).n, 0);
      assert.deepEqual(x.kho.db.prepare(
        "SELECT value FROM scheduler_meta WHERE key='durable_first_mutation_at_ms'"
      ).get(), markerBefore, 'a skipped RUNNING row does not mark a new mutation');
      assert.ok(x.kho.db.prepare(
        "SELECT 1 FROM scheduler_meta WHERE key='reconcile_cursor'"
      ).get(), 'cursor remains while the logical root is unresolved');

      x.clock.advanceMs(15_001);
      var recoveryLease = layLease(x, '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000094');
      assert.throws(function () {
        reconcileCanonicalState({
          kho: x.kho, store: x.store, world: x.world, clock: x.clock,
          leaseToken: recoveryLease, pageSize: 1
        });
      }, /RECONCILE_UNRESOLVED_CANONICAL_ROWS/);
      var retry = x.store.getById(child.id);
      assert.equal(retry.state, 'RETRY_WAIT');
      x.clock.advanceMs(Number(retry.retry_at_ms) - x.clock.nowMs());
      reconcileCanonicalState({
        kho: x.kho, store: x.store, world: x.world, clock: x.clock,
        leaseToken: recoveryLease, pageSize: 1
      });
      assert.equal(x.store.getById(child.id).state, 'CANCELLED');
      assert.equal(x.store.getById(root.id).state, 'CANCELLED');
      assert.deepEqual(x.kho.db.prepare(
        'SELECT job_id,resolves_job_id FROM event_applications WHERE job_id=?'
      ).get(child.id), {job_id: child.id, resolves_job_id: root.id});
      assert.equal(x.kho.db.prepare(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scheduler_meta WHERE key='reconcile_cursor'"
      ).get().n, 0);
    } finally { x.dong(); }
  });

      ).all();
  ```

  Each durable reconciliation page calls

  cancels only a non-global orphan with no application. A global orphan is never

  RUNNING global job remains for normal expired-claim recovery:

  ```js
  function invalidateGlobalOrphan(context, job, effectiveNowMs) {
    var claimed = context.store.claimForResolution(
      context.leaseToken,
      job.id,
      effectiveNowMs,
      15_000,
      { allowQuarantined: true, allowFuturePending: true }
    );
    var executable = context.store.loadExecutableJob(
      context.leaseToken, claimed, effectiveNowMs
    );
    // This helper is an exported trust boundary: do not trust a caller's row
    // or cached canonical_ref. Re-evaluate the validated executable payload.
    var canonicalStatus = canonicalExternalStatus(context.kho, executable.payload.ref);
    if (canonicalStatus === 'EXACT') {
      throw new Error('CANONICAL_NEUTRALIZATION_REQUIRED');
    }
    if (canonicalStatus !== 'ALREADY_ABSENT' && canonicalStatus !== 'REF_MISMATCH') {
      throw new Error('CANONICAL_EXTERNAL_STATUS_INVALID');
    }
    if (context.onInvalidationForTest) context.onInvalidationForTest('claimed', executable);
    context.store.markDurableMutation(context.leaseToken, effectiveNowMs);
    context.store.insertApplication(context.leaseToken, executable, {
      effectiveAtS: executable.scheduled_at_s,
      result: { code: 'MATCH_INVALIDATED', reconciliation: 'canonical-orphan' }
    }, effectiveNowMs);
    if (context.onInvalidationForTest) {
      context.onInvalidationForTest('application-inserted', executable);
    }
    context.store.finishResolved(
      context.leaseToken,
      executable,
      'CANCELLED',
      'MATCH_INVALIDATED',
      effectiveNowMs
    );
    if (context.onInvalidationForTest) context.onInvalidationForTest('completed', executable);
  }
  ```

  The final sweep runs under the same live lease in that final immediate UoW;

  ```sql
  SELECT j.id
  FROM event_jobs AS j
  LEFT JOIN dq AS d ON d.tk=CAST(j.aggregate_id AS INTEGER)
  WHERE j.kind='ACCOUNT_ADVANCE' AND j.state IN ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT')
    AND d.tk IS NULL
  ORDER BY j.sequence,j.id;

  SELECT j.id
  FROM event_jobs AS j
  LEFT JOIN dq AS d ON d.tk=j.source_account_id

    AND j.source_account_id IS NOT NULL
    AND j.state IN ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT','QUARANTINED')
    AND d.tk IS NULL
  ```

  The final cursor deletion, every terminal state, and every application commit

  **Thay toàn bộ fragment cutover/reconcile trước đó bằng file body có thứ tự
  dưới đây.** Đây là body cuối cùng của `server/scheduler/cutover.js`; Task 6

  ```js
  'use strict';
  var {G} = require('../rules.js');
  var {TheGioi} = require('../world.js');
  var {apDungMigrationScheduler} = require('./migrations.js');
  var {SchedulerStore, assertSchedulerOwnerId, canonicalJson} = require('./store.js');
  var {deriveExternalJobs, canonicalExternalStatus} = require('./events.js');
  var {GameAdvanceService} = require('./advance-service.js');
  var {EventReducer} = require('./reducers.js');

  function requireCutoverContext(context) {
    if (!context || !context.kho || !context.store || !context.world ||
        !context.clock || !context.leaseToken) throw new Error('CUTOVER_CONTEXT_INVALID');
    return context;
  }
  function effectiveNow(context) {
    var wall = Number(context.clock.nowMs());
    var prior = context.store.peekEffectiveNowMs(wall);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(wall) || !Number.isSafeInteger(prior)) {
      throw new Error('EFFECTIVE_NOW_INVALID');
    }
    return Math.max(wall, prior, Number(context.effectiveNowMs || 0));
  }
  function canonicalRows(kho) {
    return kho.db.prepare('SELECT * FROM dq ORDER BY tk').all().map(function (row) {
      return Object.assign({}, row, {tk: Number(row.tk), revision: Number(row.revision),
        state: row.state, st: JSON.parse(row.state)});
    });
  }
  function canonicalTargetOwners(rows) {
    var owners = new Map();
    rows.forEach(function (entry) {
      (entry.st.planets || []).forEach(function (planet) {
        var key = G.tdKey(planet.c);
        if (owners.has(key) && owners.get(key) !== entry.tk) {
          throw new Error('CANONICAL_TARGET_OWNER_CONFLICT');
        }
        owners.set(key, entry.tk);
      });
    });
    return owners;
  }
  function localWakeFor(row, owners) {
    var next = G.phanLoaiSuKienNoiBoKe(row.st, row.tk, function (targetKey) {
      return owners.has(targetKey) ? owners.get(targetKey) : null;
    });
    if (!next) return null;
    return {kind: 'ACCOUNT_ADVANCE', scheduledAtS: next.atS, priority: 200,
      aggregateType: 'account', aggregateId: String(row.tk), expectedRevision: -1,
      payload: {schemaVersion: 1, accountId: row.tk, nextLocalAtS: next.atS,
        reconcile: true, reconcileRevision: row.revision}, maxAttempts: 8};
  }
  function nextCursor(kho) {
    var row = kho.db.prepare("SELECT value FROM scheduler_meta WHERE key='reconcile_cursor'").get();
    return row ? Number(row.value) : null;
  }
  function writeCursor(kho, cursor, nowMs) {
    kho.db.prepare(
      "INSERT INTO scheduler_meta(key,value,updated_at_ms) VALUES('reconcile_cursor',?,?) " +
      "ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value,updated_at_ms=excluded.updated_at_ms"
    ).run(String(cursor), nowMs);
  ```
